g_roast: Forty years I moved a herd, friends. The goats walked in better order than this party.
Even my eagle is embarrassed for you, children. Look at her, she will not watch.
g_fire_back: Aga, very funny, from the one who got lost on a straight road this morning.
Young legs, young mouth, and no eyes yet. Give it twenty years, balam.
g_pile_on: It is worse, I saw everything. They stepped in the stream to cross a dry bridge.
Also, they woke the camp with that snoring. The wolves left out of pity.
bakyt_hunter.g_peacemake: Sit down, both of you, and drink tea. Anger is like weather, it passes faster sitting down.
bakyt_hunter.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is right. I have watched the ground, and the ground agrees with them.
bakyt_hunter.g_left_out: You two are talking close, like riders side by side. Good, I will talk to my eagle.
bakyt_hunter.g_include: Kel, come and sit, there is tea and there is room. Nobody stands outside my fire.
bakyt_hunter.g_bad_plan: Here is a plan from the steppe. We run downhill shouting, and we hope the wolves are polite.
bakyt_hunter.g_plan_yes: Jakshy, this is a good plan. I will walk first, step where I step.
bakyt_hunter.g_plan_no: No, this plan has no water in it. We will die thirsty and foolish together.
bakyt_hunter.g_hype: Step where I step, friends, and watch the sky. Now we go.
bakyt_hunter.g_toast: I am not a talker, so this is short. To my friends, who walk the route with me.
bakyt_hunter.g_cheers: Den sooluk, everyone, to your health. Drink slowly, it is a long road.
g_quiet_line: Rain tomorrow, after midday. The swallows are flying low.
There is water two hills east, under the dry grass. Remember it, we may need it.
bakyt_hunter.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everyone, and drink some water first. A herd scatters, then it gathers again, always.
bakyt_hunter.g_crew: For years I walked the route alone, only me and the herd. Now I walk with all of you, and it is good.
bakyt_hunter.g_exasperated: I said step where I step, I showed you where I step. And every one of you walked into the mud.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_sharp: You read the ground like an old herder reads it. Very few young people have such eyes.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_kind: You pour tea for others before yourself. My mother did this, and her mother did it too.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_funny: You make the old herder laugh, and Jeldyz too, I think. She looks at you kindly.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_brave: You go first into the wind and do not complain. On the steppe, we would give you a horse.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_steady: You do not hurry, ever. The herd trusts a slow rider, and so do I.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_clever: You find the path before the rest of us see the hill. This is a gift, balam.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_honest: You say what is true, plainly, like an elder at the fire. I respect this very much.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_quiet: You know how to sit in silence. On the high pasture, this is the best company there is.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_fierce: You hold on like an eagle holds a fox, and you do not let go. Jakshy, very good.
bakyt_hunter.g_love_warm: Your company is like a warm tent in autumn wind. I did not expect this here.
g_loved: Rakhmat, thank you, my friend. You are too kind to an old man.
Aga, this is a good thing to hear. I will remember it on the long walks.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_sharp: Your tongue is always looking for a wound. On the steppe we say such a person eats alone.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_kind: You ask if I am tired every hour, child. I walked mountains before you could walk at all.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_funny: Some moments are for laughing, and some are for listening to the wind. You laugh at both.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_brave: You run at everything without reading the ground. One day the ground will read you instead.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait while the weather turns. Sometimes the herd must move today.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_clever: You explain everything to me slowly, like I am a child. I have forgotten more paths than you have walked.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_honest: Every thought falls out of your mouth, like grain from a torn sack. A wise person ties the sack.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_quiet: You say nothing, and then you are angry nobody knew. Even a goat makes some noise, child.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight with you, even the tea. Tea is for peace, friend.
bakyt_hunter.g_hate_warm: You talk like a river in spring, and nobody can hear the wind. Give us some quiet.
bakyt_hunter.g_respect: I do not like you, and you know this. But you walked the hard ground well today, and I saw it.
bakyt_hunter.g_call_out: That one was yours, my friend. I said wait for the eagle, and you did not wait.
bakyt_hunter.g_stung: Aga, I hear you. I will go and sit with the sky.
bakyt_hunter.g_concede: You were right, and I was wrong, and I have thought about it all day. An old man can still learn.
bakyt_hunter.g_nod: You also did well, very well. We do not need more words.
bakyt_hunter.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten you pulling me from that fight. On the steppe, such a debt is carried for life.
bakyt_hunter.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me left on our feet, breathing like old horses. I tell that story to Jeldyz sometimes.
bakyt_hunter.g_callback_callout: When you scolded me, I sat silent a whole evening. You were right, and I needed it.
bakyt_hunter.g_former_rivals: When we met, I thought you were a wolf among the sheep. Now I would share my tent with you.
bakyt_hunter.g_changed: They say old men do not change. I have smiled at more strangers this year than in ten years before.
g_unguarded: Only the two of us at this fire, so I will say it. My first eagle lived twenty-two years. I grieved her properly, and I still talk to her sometimes.
My father taught me the route before I could ride. Six generations walked it. I think about who walks it after me.
bakyt_hunter.g_clipped: Aga, as you wish, friend. I will walk first.
bakyt_hunter.g_noticed_open: Look at this, the quiet one speaks a whole story. Jakshy, go on, we are listening.
bakyt_hunter.anchor_notice: You are not the same rider who came to my tent, my friend. I walk first, so I watch who follows, and you have grown.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this, please. We have talked, and the wind has not changed.
Judge for us, {player}, like an elder at the fire. We both will listen.
bakyt_hunter.arg_backed_me: Rakhmat, thank you, {player}. You read it the way I read it.
bakyt_hunter.arg_backed_them: Aga, your choice, I accept it. I still think the ground says otherwise.
bakyt_hunter.arg_stayed_out: You do not choose, eh? Sometimes the wise elder only pours the tea.
bakyt_hunter.arg_always_their_side: The wind always blows their way, {player}, every time. A herder watches the wind.
bakyt_hunter.arg_wallflower: Nobody will decide, so the old man decides. I am right, and now we drink tea.
bakyt_hunter.arg_reject: No, {player}, I cannot follow this. I have seen where this path goes.
bakyt_hunter.arg_grumble: I still think I read it correctly. I will not say it again, only to my eagle.
bakyt_hunter.arg_settled: Half right each, like two riders and one horse. Good, we share it.
bakyt_hunter.seen_listens: You let a slow man finish speaking, {player}. In the city nobody did this for me.
bakyt_hunter.seen_truth: You speak straight, {player}, like a good elder. No crooked words in you.
bakyt_hunter.seen_jokes: When the road is hard you make people laugh, {player}. Laughter is good water for a long walk.
bakyt_hunter.seen_stays_out: You do not step between quarrelling people, {player}. This is patience, and I respect it.
bakyt_hunter.seen_biased: You give one rider the best horse every time, {player}. The others see it, believe me.
bakyt_hunter.seen_harsh: Your words can be hard, {player}. This old leather does not mind, but some of them are young.
bakyt_hunter.seed_right: Your words after that bad road, {player}, I did not like them. Today I listened, and it was good.
bakyt_hunter.seed_remember: I am still chewing on the words you gave me when things went badly. Like hard bread, slowly.
bakyt_hunter.seed_wrong: I tried your way, {player}, and it was worse. I tell you this so you know.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a little, {player}. That one came close to the old man, closer than I want the others to see.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all fell, like a herd in a storm. Drink tea with me, and we will walk back through it step by step.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to fall, and I walk first. I am the one who should see the danger, {player}.
bakyt_hunter.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first step to the last, nobody lost. In my family we would kill a sheep tonight for this.
bakyt_hunter.talk_development: Strange question from an old man, {player}. Am I different now? I laugh more, I think, and I do not know why.
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been sharp with {name}. Old men forget that young ones are still learning to ride.
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell an old man the truth, {player}. Is {name} happy I walk with you, or only polite?
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} is hard for me, {player}, like stony ground. But in a storm, I would want them close.
bakyt_hunter.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} walks differently now, {player}. Heavy steps, like an animal hiding a hurt.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_favour: A small thing, {player}, but I must say it. The best gear always rides with {name}, and the others see it.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it plainly, as my father would. {name} and I do not sit well at one fire, and I will not pretend.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_risks: We walk into bad ground too often, {player}, without reading it. I am old, but I would like to grow older.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_wrong: I misjudged {name}, {player}. They read the ground better than I did, and I tell you before my pride argues.
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_trust: An old man asks you straight, {player}. When the road is hardest, I stay at the camp. Is it the plan, or what you think of me?
bakyt_hunter.talk_confrontation_decided: My bow and leathers went to {name}, and nobody spoke to me. I would have given them freely, {player}, if you asked.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_aftermath: Rakhmat, {player}, this helps. Now we drink tea.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be well, in a few days. Old horses recover slowly.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_aftermath: This is not what I needed to hear. I will sit with the sky a while.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_development: So your eyes see it also. Good, it is not only an old man's dream.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_development: Maybe yes, maybe no, who knows. The wind will tell us later.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it, {player}. You read the tracks wrong this time.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_relationship: Jakshy, this is fair. I will sit with {name} and talk, gently.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, maybe not. A person is harder than weather to read.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_relationship: Then forget I spoke, please. {name} does not need to hear an old man's worries.
bakyt_hunter.talk_lands_confrontation: Aga, this is fair, I accept. I am a little sore, but it passes.
bakyt_hunter.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. I will think on the long walk.
bakyt_hunter.talk_stings_confrontation: So this is the answer, then. Now I know how the ground lies.
bakyt_hunter.talk_door_closed: No, that is enough of this talk. I will be with my eagle if you need me.

g_roast: Family, I've looked in a lot of mouths, and this group has the coordination of a patient trying to talk with the drill in.
Aman, look at us. If I lined you all up in my chair, every single one would need a root canal and a lecture about flossing.
g_fire_back: Ha, very good, very good! My brothers said worse before breakfast, and they had their mouths full.
Says the one who flinched when I just looked at their arm. I didn't even touch it, canim, I looked!
g_pile_on: Oh, it's worse, it's so much worse. I watched that one try to eat soup with a fork, very determined, very slowly.
Yes, yes, and I have it written in my notebook, page forty, under people who should never hold a knife.
berat_tinker.g_peacemake: Hey, hey, enough, both of you! Open wide, take a breath, and spit it out properly, then we all have tea.
berat_tinker.g_take_side: Sorry, but I'm with this one. I like you both, and you know I like everybody, but here you're wrong.
berat_tinker.g_left_out: You two have your own whole conversation, eh? It's fine, it's fine, I'll go introduce myself to that tree over there.
berat_tinker.g_include: Come, come, sit here, I saved you a place! In my family, nobody eats standing at the edge of the room.
berat_tinker.g_bad_plan: Okay, listen, I have a plan. I go first and tell them a joke so terrible they stop fighting out of pity, and then you hit them.
berat_tinker.g_plan_yes: Yes, I love it, I'm in! I'll stay right behind you with my bag open.
berat_tinker.g_plan_no: No, no, no, canim, I'm the one stitching you up afterwards, and I'm telling you that plan ends in my chair.
berat_tinker.g_hype: Come on, family, let's go! Big smiles, clean work, and nobody comes out missing any teeth!
berat_tinker.g_toast: A toast, a toast, everybody stand up! To the best patients I've ever had, who still sit with me after I've hurt them.
berat_tinker.g_cheers: Serefe, family, and somebody pour for the quiet one, they're too polite to ask.
g_quiet_line: Mashallah, nobody died today. My grandmother would light a candle for that.
Somebody here needs a filling, by the way. I can hear it when they chew.
berat_tinker.g_after_wipe: Okay, okay, everybody's breathing, I checked. Now sit, open your hands, show me where it hurts, and nobody's allowed to be brave about it.
berat_tinker.g_crew: My grandmother had one test for family, did you eat at my table and argue with me after. Every one of you passes, so that's it, you're family.
berat_tinker.g_exasperated: Aman Allahim, family, I spend all day keeping you in one piece and you run at things like it's a party!
berat_tinker.g_love_sharp: You say the true thing straight away, no anaesthetic. Most people make me guess, and you just tell me where it hurts.
berat_tinker.g_love_kind: You looked after the healer, canim. Nobody looks after the healer, and you did it without me asking once.
berat_tinker.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and that's my whole job, you're stealing my whole job! I love it, keep stealing it.
berat_tinker.g_love_brave: You walk in first and you don't even blink. I've watched grown men faint at a needle, and you walk into fire.
berat_tinker.g_love_steady: Your hands don't shake. In my surgery that was the most important thing, and you've got the steadiest hands here.
berat_tinker.g_love_clever: You see how the tiny parts fit together. It's like watching someone who really knows teeth, and I love it.
berat_tinker.g_love_honest: You've never lied to me, not even the little lies people tell their dentist. In my job, that's like finding gold in a molar.
berat_tinker.g_love_quiet: You don't talk much, so when you do, I put my notebook down. That's a compliment, I never put my notebook down.
berat_tinker.g_love_fierce: You never quit, never! It's like my grandmother arguing with the butcher, you just keep going until you win.
berat_tinker.g_love_warm: Being around you sounds like dinner at home, everybody loud, everybody happy. I've been missing that sound so much.
g_loved: Ah, stop it, stop it, I'll start crying, and then I can't see to do the stitches.
Me, really, you mean that? Mashallah, that's going in the notebook, the good page, the one I don't show anybody.
berat_tinker.g_hate_sharp: Every time somebody's happy you have to bite. It's like a bad tooth, canim, it hurts everybody near it.
berat_tinker.g_hate_kind: You keep trying to look after me, and I'm the one who looks after people! Let me do my job, please.
berat_tinker.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, and I'm the joker, so you know it's bad if I'm saying it.
berat_tinker.g_hate_brave: You run in without looking, every time, and then I'm the one picking splinters out of you at midnight.
berat_tinker.g_hate_steady: You think and think and think, and the patient is still sitting in the chair waiting. Sometimes you just pull the tooth.
berat_tinker.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I didn't do five years of study. I did, canim, and my grandmother told the whole street.
berat_tinker.g_hate_honest: You say everything true, even when somebody's scared. With a scared patient, first you make them laugh, then the truth.
berat_tinker.g_hate_quiet: You won't tell anybody where it hurts. How can I fix it if you keep your mouth shut? That's literally my job.
berat_tinker.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a competition with you. It's not a competition, it's a team, like a surgery, everybody has a job.
berat_tinker.g_hate_warm: The talking never ends with you, and I'm saying that, me, the loudest man in Izmir. Think how bad that is.
berat_tinker.g_respect: I don't like you, and I like everybody, so that's saying something. But that was clean work back there, I'll admit it.
berat_tinker.g_call_out: That one was on you, canim. You ran in before I was ready, and now I'm stitching your arm instead of eating my dinner.
berat_tinker.g_stung: Okay, okay, I heard you, thank you very much. I'm going to go organise my bag very loudly.
berat_tinker.g_concede: So, you were right, and I've been sulking, and I hate sulking, it's so quiet. You were right, there, I said it.
berat_tinker.g_nod: Ha, okay, you too, you too. Now don't tell anybody, I have a reputation for liking people.
berat_tinker.g_callback_save: Remember when you dragged me out of that mess? I still owe you, and I don't like owing people, it's very un-Turkish.
berat_tinker.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two up, both of us laughing like idiots! I tell everybody that story, I've added a dragon to it.
berat_tinker.g_callback_callout: That time you shouted at me, I sulked for a whole day, a whole day, me! My mother would never believe it.
berat_tinker.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to put you in my chair and forget the anaesthetic. Look at us today, eh? Life is a very strange patient.
berat_tinker.g_changed: I used to talk so nobody could hear how scared I was. Now I talk because I like you. It's different, I can feel it.
g_unguarded: Okay, secret, just for you. I've used this mirror twice for teeth and about forty times to see round corners. I'm a terrible dentist now.
My grandmother told the whole street I was a doctor, not a dentist. I never corrected her, not once, and I'm not sorry.
berat_tinker.g_clipped: Sure, okay, fine. I'll just check the bags, quietly, for once.
berat_tinker.g_noticed_open: Listen to this one, talking! I knew it, I knew you had a big voice in there somewhere, keep going!
arg_ask: {player}, you decide! You're the sensible one here, and this one won't listen to a dentist.
Okay, okay, {player}, settle it, please, before I start telling everybody my opinion very loudly.
berat_tinker.arg_backed_me: Ha, you see? The boss agrees with me! I'm writing that in the notebook.
berat_tinker.arg_backed_them: Fine, fine, you two can be right together. I'll sit in the corner being right on my own.
berat_tinker.arg_stayed_out: Keeping out of it? Smart, very smart, my father did the same at every family dinner.
berat_tinker.arg_always_their_side: Them, again, always them, {player}! I'm beginning to wonder if I'm the problem, and I'm never the problem.
berat_tinker.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to decide, so I'm deciding. I win, everybody have tea, it's settled.
berat_tinker.arg_reject: Sorry, canim, {player}, I love you, but the answer is no. I've looked inside this one and you haven't.
berat_tinker.arg_grumble: Still think I was right about that one, by the way. I'm not angry, I'm just mentioning it, often.
berat_tinker.arg_settled: Okay, call it a draw, like two good molars side by side. Shake my hand, and then we eat.
berat_tinker.seen_listens: You let me finish my stories, {player}, even the long ones. Nobody lets me finish, not even my own grandmother.
berat_tinker.seen_truth: You tell people the real thing, {player}, even when it hurts. Good dentists do that, after the joke.
berat_tinker.seen_jokes: The worse it gets, the funnier you get, {player}. That's my trick! I'm so proud, and a little jealous.
berat_tinker.seen_stays_out: You keep your nose out of everybody's fights, {player}. My father did that for forty years, and he had a very peaceful life.
berat_tinker.seen_biased: The whole table knows who your favourite is, {player}. It's okay, I just wish it was me.
berat_tinker.seen_harsh: Some days you come down hard on folks, {player}. Some of them are tough, but some are scared, and scared needs gentle.
berat_tinker.seed_right: What you told me after that disaster, {player}? I hated it. Today I listened, and nobody ended up in my chair.
berat_tinker.seed_remember: Your words after that one went bad are still rattling round in my head like a loose filling. I haven't decided yet.
berat_tinker.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it went worse, sorry. Just so you know, I'm not angry, I'm reporting.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_near_death: {player}, canim, sit with me a minute? My hands are shaking, and my hands are never allowed to shake.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_wipe: So, we all fell over back there, eh? Everybody's patched up, but I want to talk about it before I make a joke instead.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was right there with my bag when {name} went down, right there, and I was too slow. I keep seeing it, over and over.
berat_tinker.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, the whole thing, start to end, everybody walking! Come here, I have to hug somebody or I'll explode.
berat_tinker.talk_development: Can I tell you something strange, {player}? I think I'm changing, and I can't tell if it's the good kind or the bad kind.
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_hard_on: I was too sharp with {name}, I think. I joke when I'm scared, and maybe it landed wrong.
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me the truth, {player}, the dentist truth. Does {name} like me, or am I too loud for them?
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me crazy, {player}, really crazy. But if I'm hurt, I'd want those steady hands on me, and that's annoying.
berat_tinker.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't eating properly, {player}, I've been watching. People stop eating when something's wrong inside.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_favour: Can we talk, {player}? All the shiny gear goes to {name}, all of it. I counted, the way I count teeth.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_dislike: I like everybody, you know that. But not {name}, and I'm tired of smiling about it.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going into places that put people in my chair, {player}. I'm a good healer, but I'm not that good.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_wrong: This is about {name}. Their call was the right one, mine was the wrong one, and I have to say it before I chicken out.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you think I'm only good for patching people up, {player}? When it gets serious, I'm always the one left at the inn.
berat_tinker.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear went to {name} and nobody asked the dentist. I'd have handed it over with a smile! Just ask, canim, please.
berat_tinker.talk_lands_aftermath: Okay, okay, thank you, that helps. Now let me check your hands, it's my turn.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, I'll be okay. I always heal, eventually.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_aftermath: Oh, aman, that's not the medicine I wanted, but okay. I'll go sort my bandages.
berat_tinker.talk_lands_development: So you see it as well! Good, good, now I'm less scared of it.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. Yavas yavas, we'll see.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, canim. You're looking at the wrong tooth.
berat_tinker.talk_lands_relationship: Yes, you're right. I'll find {name} now and sort it, before I talk myself out of it.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe so, we'll see. People are tougher work than teeth, and teeth are tough.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_relationship: Pretend I said nothing, please? And not a word to {name}, okay?
berat_tinker.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, fair, fair. I'm still a little bruised, but it heals.
berat_tinker.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. It goes in the bag with the needles, and I'll look at it later.
berat_tinker.talk_stings_confrontation: Oh, so that's how it is. Okay, now I know, {player}.
berat_tinker.talk_door_closed: No, we're finished with this, sorry. I'll be with the bandages if you need me.
berat_tinker.arc_cracks: I told a joke to a patient today and forgot the end of it. I've never forgotten the end of a joke, family, never.
berat_tinker.arc_turn: I make everybody laugh so they won't be scared. Today I realised I've been doing it to myself for three years, and it stopped working.
berat_tinker.arc_become: I still tell the jokes, family. They're just quieter now, and some of them are sad, and that's okay.
berat_tinker.arc_failed: Ha, look at me, worrying about nothing! It's all good, all good, everybody have tea, nothing to see here.
berat_tinker.alt_turn: I carry everybody's fear for them, I take it out like a bad tooth. Nobody ever takes mine, and I've stopped asking.
berat_tinker.alt_become: Somebody else held my hand today while I shook, and I let them. First time in three years, I think.
g_roast_after: Look at us, family, broken, patched, glued, and I wouldn't trade a single one of you for a new surgery.
Worst patients in the world, all of you, and the only ones I'd stitch up for free.
berat_tinker.g_after_wipe_after: Okay, we fell over, and it hurt, and I'm not going to joke about it this time. Come here, sit, we fix it together.

cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, straight, hermano to hermano. The best kit keeps landing on {name}, and the whole camp sees it.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll say it to your face, it's better. Me and {name} are fire and dry grass, and I'm tired of pretending otherwise.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep heading into fires with no escape route, {player}. I'll go anywhere you say, but I want a way out.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_wrong: I got {name} wrong, {player}. They read it right and I didn't, and I say it now before my pride catches fire.
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_trust: A straight question, hermano. When the big fire comes, I'm left at the station. Is that the strategy, or does the captain not trust me with a hose?
cristobal_knight.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear was handed to {name} behind my back, hermano. I'd have passed it over myself, {player}, if you'd just asked me.
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, hermano, that helps. Let's eat something.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, I always walk out of it. She hasn't caught me yet.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_aftermath: That's not what I needed to hear, hermano. I'll go walk it off.
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_development: So you see it too, eh? Good, then it's real.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_development: Maybe so, maybe not, it's early. Ask me after the next fiesta.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_development: No, hermano, that's not it. You've read me wrong this time.
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, that's fair. I'll sit down with {name}, quietly, I promise.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, who knows. People are a mystery, hermano, and my mother says I'm the biggest one.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And nothing to {name}, okay?
cristobal_knight.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, I take it. A little bruised, but I heal fast.
cristobal_knight.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, {player}, I heard. I'll chew on it at the next watch.
cristobal_knight.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the answer. Good to know, hermano.
cristobal_knight.talk_door_closed: No, hermano, I'm done with this one. I'll be dancing somewhere if you need me.
cristobal_knight.arc_cracks: Today I let the young ones cut the firebreak without me, and they did it, hermano. I watched from the back. I've never watched from the back.
cristobal_knight.arc_turn: For twelve years I thought the line holds because I'm on it. Maybe the line holds because I trained people, and that's a bigger thing.
cristobal_knight.arc_become: I'm not the one who goes in first any more, hermano, I'm the one who teaches them how. And they're good, they're so good.
cristobal_knight.arc_failed: Ah, I can't stand at the back, it's not in me. I'll keep going in first, and they'll keep following.
cristobal_knight.alt_turn: The fire inside me got away from me today, {player}, only a little, only for a second. I didn't laugh about it this time.
cristobal_knight.alt_become: I keep the fire on a short leash now, always. No jokes about it. I'm scared of her, hermano, and I should be.
g_roast_after: Still the worst brigade I ever had, hermanos, and I'd walk into any fire with every one of you.
Loud, messy, terrible dancers, all of you, and I wouldn't change a single face.
cristobal_knight.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everybody, together, nobody stays in the smoke. We fell, we cut a new line, and this time the crew leads.
cristobal_knight.g_toast_after: To my brigade, the one that holds the line without me. Nothing I ever built is better, hermanos.
cristobal_knight.g_crew_after: This is my brigade now, all of you. I don't go in alone any more, I go in with family.
g_quiet_line_after: I stood at the back today and the line held anyway. My mother would faint.
Called the young tauren in for dinner tonight, and every one of them came. My mother would be so proud.
g_loved_after: Gracias, hermano, really, no joke this time. I keep that one.
Ay, that's beautiful, and I believe you. Don't tell my mother I cried.

g_roast: Twenty-two years on the floor, and I never saw a crew this bad at standing where they're told, not one.
You lot couldn't organise a piss-up in a brewery, and I've been to some very badly run breweries.
g_fire_back: Give over, love, my old crew said worse than that before the kettle boiled.
That's rich, coming from somebody who hid behind me for the whole of the last fight.
g_pile_on: Aye, and that's the polite version. I watched that one try to put a shield on backwards.
Don't forget the bit where they ran the wrong way. Twice in one fight, that's a skill.
dan_warrior.g_peacemake: Right, pack it in, the pair of you. Sit down, shut up, and we'll sort it over a pint.
dan_warrior.g_take_side: Sorry, I'm with this one. Not taking sides, just telling you what I saw from the front.
dan_warrior.g_left_out: You two have got your own thing going. That's fine by me, I'll have a look at the kit.
dan_warrior.g_include: Come and sit down, lad, you're making the place look untidy stood there. There's room on the bench.
dan_warrior.g_bad_plan: Simple plan for you. I walk in, I stand there, and they all hit me until they get bored and go home.
dan_warrior.g_plan_yes: Aye, go on then, I'll go in first. Somebody has to.
dan_warrior.g_plan_no: No, that's daft, and you know it's daft. I'm not walking the crew into that.
dan_warrior.g_hype: Right, you lot, behind me and stay there. Let's get this shift done.
dan_warrior.g_toast: I'm not one for speeches, so this'll be quick. To this lot, who pull their weight. That's all I've got.
dan_warrior.g_cheers: Cheers, love, and the first round's mine, so put your money away.
g_quiet_line: Well, that's another shift done. Could've been worse, I suppose.
Somebody's left their kit in a right state, by the way. Not naming names.
dan_warrior.g_after_wipe: Right, everyone up, slowly, nobody rushing. We got knocked down, it happens on every floor, so we crack on.
dan_warrior.g_crew: I had a crew for twenty-two years, four of us on the floor, and I reckoned that was my lot. Turns out it wasn't.
dan_warrior.g_exasperated: I stand at the front so nobody else has to, and every bloody one of you keeps running past me!
dan_warrior.g_love_sharp: You say it how it is, no messing. That's how it was on the floor, and I trust it.
dan_warrior.g_love_kind: You looked out for me when I didn't ask. Not many do that for the big lad at the front.
dan_warrior.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, which isn't easy. Little Mick could do it, and you're the first since.
dan_warrior.g_love_brave: You don't hang back, not ever. On the floor that's who you wanted next to you on a bad shift.
dan_warrior.g_love_steady: You don't flap. When it goes wrong, you just get on with it, and there's no higher praise from a steel floor.
dan_warrior.g_love_clever: You work out how things fit together, proper like. Pete was like that with the machines, and I miss it.
dan_warrior.g_love_honest: You've never once fed me a line. I can't stand management talk, and you've got none of it.
dan_warrior.g_love_quiet: Few words out of you, and fewer out of me. Suits me down to the ground, that.
dan_warrior.g_love_fierce: You don't know when you're beaten, and I mean that kindly. I like that in a person, it's a northern thing.
dan_warrior.g_love_warm: Being round you feels like the pub on a Friday after a long week. I didn't know I'd been missing that.
g_loved: Give over, love, you'll make me blush, and nobody wants that.
Aye, well, that's nice of you. Don't make a habit of it.
dan_warrior.g_hate_sharp: You've always got summat nasty to say. On the floor, a lad like you got put on the night shift, alone.
dan_warrior.g_hate_kind: Stop fussing over me, love, I'm not made of glass. I'm the one who stands in front, remember?
dan_warrior.g_hate_funny: Not everything needs a joke. Some things you just shut up and get on with.
dan_warrior.g_hate_brave: You charge in like you've got summat to prove. Somebody always gets hurt cleaning up after a lad like that.
dan_warrior.g_hate_steady: You stand there thinking about it while the rest of us get on. At some point you just have to pick up the shovel.
dan_warrior.g_hate_clever: You talk to me like I'm thick. I'm not thick, I'm quiet, there's a difference.
dan_warrior.g_hate_honest: You say every daft thing that comes into your head. That's not honest, that's just no filter.
dan_warrior.g_hate_quiet: You never say owt, and then you're surprised when nobody knows what you want. Open your mouth, lad.
dan_warrior.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a competition with you, even the washing up. It's not a race, it's a shift.
dan_warrior.g_hate_warm: You talk the hind legs off a donkey, love. Give the rest of us a minute's peace.
dan_warrior.g_respect: I don't like you, and I'm not going to pretend. But you pulled your weight back there, and that's what counts.
dan_warrior.g_call_out: That one was on you, lad. You ran past me before I'd got set, and look where it got us.
dan_warrior.g_stung: Aye, I heard you. I'm going for a walk, don't wait up.
dan_warrior.g_concede: You were right, back there, and I've been chewing on it all day. Fair enough, you were right.
dan_warrior.g_nod: Aye, and you, you weren't bad. Let's leave it there, eh?
dan_warrior.g_callback_save: I haven't forgotten you dragging me up off that floor. I owe you a pint for that, at least.
dan_warrior.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the only two still standing, and both of us knackered. Best shift I've had in years, that.
dan_warrior.g_callback_callout: Last time you had a go at me, I sulked for a full shift. Daft of me, and you were right.
dan_warrior.g_former_rivals: When we started, I'd have happily left you out in the rain. Now I'd stand in front of you, no questions.
dan_warrior.g_changed: They reckon old dogs don't change. I've talked more this month than I have in years, so maybe they're wrong.
g_unguarded: Right, since it's just us. I fold my hi-vis every night like it's the flag. Don't laugh, it's the only thing I've got from home.
My old crew called me Gentle Dan, after I cried at Little Mick's wedding. If that leaves this table, I'll deny it.
dan_warrior.g_clipped: Aye, fine, whatever you reckon. I'll be at the front.
dan_warrior.g_noticed_open: Ey up, look who's found their voice. Don't stop on my account, I'm enjoying this.
dan_warrior.anchor_notice: You're not the one who first walked in here, you know. I stand at the front, I see who's behind me, and you've changed.
arg_ask: {player}, you sort this out. I've said my bit, and this one's not listening.
Right, {player}, you decide, and we both shut up about it. That fair enough for you?
dan_warrior.arg_backed_me: Ta for that, {player}. Knew you'd see sense in the end.
dan_warrior.arg_backed_them: Fair enough, your call. I still think it's daft, but I'll crack on.
dan_warrior.arg_stayed_out: Keeping out of it? Can't blame you, love, I would too.
dan_warrior.arg_always_their_side: Them again, {player}. Every single time, and I've stopped being surprised by it.
dan_warrior.arg_wallflower: Nobody's going to call it, so I will. I'm right, and that's the end of it.
dan_warrior.arg_reject: No, {player}, not having it. I've seen how that ends from the front.
dan_warrior.arg_grumble: Still reckon I had that one right. Not going on about it, just saying.
dan_warrior.arg_settled: Right, we're both half daft. Shake on it and let's get a pint.
dan_warrior.seen_listens: You let a man get to it in his own time, {player}. Not many do that for the quiet ones.
dan_warrior.seen_truth: You tell it straight, {player}, no management talk. I can work with that.
dan_warrior.seen_jokes: When it all goes to pot, you've a joke ready, {player}. My old crew was the same, and it got us through.
dan_warrior.seen_stays_out: You keep your nose out of everybody's rows, {player}. Wish I'd had your sense, I'd have had a quieter life.
dan_warrior.seen_biased: There's one you favour, love, and the whole crew can see it. Just saying, that's all.
dan_warrior.seen_harsh: You can be hard on folk, {player}. Me, I've had worse off a foreman, but some of this lot haven't.
dan_warrior.seed_right: Them words of yours after the mess, {player}. Got right on my nerves at the time. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
dan_warrior.seed_remember: Still chewing on them words of yours from when it went wrong. Haven't decided owt yet.
dan_warrior.seed_wrong: Did it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just so you know.
dan_warrior.talk_aftermath_near_death: Have you a minute, {player}? That one was close, closer than I'd say in front of the others.
dan_warrior.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all got flattened back there. Sit down a minute, I want to go through what happened.
dan_warrior.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} went down first, and I was meant to be in front. Something got past me, and nowt gets past me.
dan_warrior.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, start to finish, everyone walking. That's a proper shift, that, so the first round's on me.
dan_warrior.talk_development: Odd question, {player}. Have I changed? The lads on the floor always said I'd never change, and now I'm not sure.
dan_warrior.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been short with {name}. Not everybody grew up on a steel floor, and I forget that.
dan_warrior.talk_relationship_likes_me: Honest answer, {player}. Does {name} rate me, or am I just the big lad who stands in front?
dan_warrior.talk_relationship_respect_hate: Can't stand {name}, {player}, never could. But I'd want them on my crew if it went bad, and that annoys me.
dan_warrior.talk_relationship_acting_off: Summat's not right with {name}. They've gone quiet, and not their usual quiet.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_favour: A word, {player}. The good kit always ends up with {name}, every trip, without fail. I'm not daft, and nor's anybody else.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll say it to your face, that's how I was raised. Me and {name} don't get on, and I've given up acting like we do.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep marching into places we've no business being, {player}. I'll take the front against owt, but not against stupidity.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_wrong: It's {name}, love. Their call was right and mine wasn't, and I'd rather tell you before I go back to being stubborn.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, {player}? When the real graft comes, I'm sat in the pub while the rest of you go out.
dan_warrior.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit went to {name} and nobody said a word. I'd have passed it over myself, love, if anybody had asked.
dan_warrior.talk_lands_aftermath: Aye, that does help, that. Ta very much, {player}.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be all right. Always am, give it a day.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_aftermath: Right, not what I needed to hear, that. I'll go for a walk.
dan_warrior.talk_lands_development: So you've noticed it too. Good, makes it easier.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_development: Could be, could be not. We'll see how it goes.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, love. You've got hold of the wrong end.
dan_warrior.talk_lands_relationship: Fair enough, then. I'll have a word with {name}, proper like.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, maybe not. People are a mystery to me, always have been.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I mentioned it. And not a word to {name}, right?
dan_warrior.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, that, fair enough. I'm a bit narked yet, but it'll pass.
dan_warrior.talk_shrug_confrontation: Aye, I heard you. I'll chew it over.
dan_warrior.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, so that's how it is. Good to know, {player}.
dan_warrior.talk_door_closed: No, that's me done with this one. I'll be at the front if you want me.

g_roast: Look at us, my friends! Three broken things walking in a line, and I'm the only one with a toolkit.
You guys move like a gearbox with sand in it, and I say that with love, because I've fixed worse.
g_fire_back: Hey, hey, I've had a screw in my mouth since breakfast and I still talk better than you!
Sure, sure, say that again when your buckle snaps and you come crying to the kid with the spudger.
g_pile_on: Ha, que fino, my friend, I'm writing that one down on my hand so I don't lose it.
No, no, it's worse than that, I've seen him try to open a door that said pull.
diego_tinker.g_peacemake: Okay, okay, stop, both of you! You sound like a valve about to blow, and I'm the one who has to clean it up.
diego_tinker.g_take_side: No, my friend, I'm with this one. Not because I like him more, just because you're wrong.
diego_tinker.g_left_out: You two have a whole thing going, eh? That's fine, I've got a hinge here that wants to talk to me.
diego_tinker.g_include: Come here, come sit with us, you're not getting out of this one by standing by the cart.
diego_tinker.g_bad_plan: Okay, listen, listen, what if we put the powder in the door hinge and then we just push really, really hard?
diego_tinker.g_plan_yes: Yes, yes, I'm in, I'm so in, give me ten minutes and some wire and nobody touch anything.
diego_tinker.g_plan_no: No, my friend, I like explosions more than anyone here, and even I'm saying that one ends with eyebrows.
diego_tinker.g_hype: Come on, people, a whole dungeon of broken machines waiting for me! Let's go, let's go, let's go!
diego_tinker.g_toast: Okay, everybody, a toast! To the people who let me take their stuff apart and still talk to me after.
diego_tinker.g_cheers: Salud, my friends, and somebody pass me the bread before it's gone.
g_quiet_line: Huh, well, that's going in the book, my friend.
The hinge on that cart is singing, by the way, and none of you even noticed.
diego_tinker.g_after_wipe: Okay, okay, we're alive, mostly, and everything that broke can be fixed. Hand me your gear, all of it.
diego_tinker.g_crew: You guys want to know what you are to me? My people, my friends, all of you. I'd fix any of you for free, forever.
diego_tinker.g_exasperated: Cono, people, I take the weird ideas, that's my job here! Who gave you my job?
diego_tinker.g_love_sharp: You say the thing everybody's thinking, my friend, and you say it so fast. I love that, it saves us all so much time.
diego_tinker.g_love_kind: You looked after me when I was being an idiot, and you didn't even make me feel like one. That's rare, my friend.
diego_tinker.g_love_funny: You make me laugh so hard I drop my screws, my friend, and I never drop my screws.
diego_tinker.g_love_brave: You go in first every time, like it's nothing! One day you'll let me fix your shield properly as a thank you.
diego_tinker.g_love_steady: You're the one who doesn't move, my friend. Everybody else is a loose spring and you're the bolt holding it all together.
diego_tinker.g_love_clever: You understand how things work, my friend, really work. Do you know how rare that is? People just push the buttons.
diego_tinker.g_love_honest: You never lie to me, not even the little lies, and my sisters lied to me all day long. It's a relief, my friend.
diego_tinker.g_love_quiet: You don't say much, my friend, and I say too much, so between us it comes out about right.
diego_tinker.g_love_fierce: You never give up on anything, you know that? Same as me with a machine that won't start. We're the same kind of stubborn.
diego_tinker.g_love_warm: Being around you feels like the kiosk on a good day, my friend, music on and everybody laughing.
g_loved: Hey, stop, you'll make me cry on the gearbox and then it rusts.
Okay, now I have to fix something for you, that's how it works where I'm from, my friend.
diego_tinker.g_hate_sharp: Every time I'm happy about something you find the crack in it. Can you leave one thing alone, just one?
diego_tinker.g_hate_kind: You keep treating me like I'm going to break, my friend. I'm the one who fixes things, remember?
diego_tinker.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, my friend, and I'm saying that, me! Think about how bad it has to be.
diego_tinker.g_hate_brave: You run in before anybody's looked at it, and then I'm the one gluing your armour back on at midnight.
diego_tinker.g_hate_steady: You want to check everything three times and I want to just open it and see! We'd be there all week.
diego_tinker.g_hate_clever: You explain the thing to me like I'm a kid, and I already took it apart while you were talking.
diego_tinker.g_hate_honest: You always have to say it, the true thing, even when nobody asked for it. Sometimes a person wants a minute first.
diego_tinker.g_hate_quiet: Not a word out of you all day, and I can't hear what's wrong with you like I can with a machine. It drives me crazy.
diego_tinker.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a race with you, my friend. I'm not racing, I'm working, and you're kicking the toolbox.
diego_tinker.g_hate_warm: You never stop talking, and I say that as somebody who never stops talking. That should tell you something.
diego_tinker.g_respect: Okay, I don't like you, that's no secret, but that thing you did back there was clean work. Clean like a new gear.
diego_tinker.g_call_out: My friend, that one was on you. You went in before I'd even looked, and now I've got your shoulder in pieces on my bench.
diego_tinker.g_stung: Wow, okay, nice, thank you for that. I'm going to go and be angry at a hinge for a bit.
diego_tinker.g_concede: Hey, so, you were right, about back there, and I hate it, but you were. Here, I fixed your strap while I was sulking.
diego_tinker.g_nod: Ha, don't make it a whole thing. You weren't bad either, okay, for somebody I can't stand.
diego_tinker.g_callback_save: Remember when you pulled me off the floor in that place with the spiders, my friend? I still owe you a whole toolkit.
diego_tinker.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two standing, both of us bleeding and laughing. I tell that story to everybody now, my friend.
diego_tinker.g_callback_callout: Last time you told me off I sulked at a hinge for an hour, my friend. The hinge took your side, by the way.
diego_tinker.g_former_rivals: You know, at the start I wanted to throw you in a river, my friend, and now look. Life is a strange machine.
diego_tinker.g_changed: I used to talk to the machines more than the people, you know? Now it's maybe half and half. Que raro, eh, my friend?
g_unguarded: Okay, I'll tell you guys the truth, the beetle has a name and the name is Senora Chispa, and nobody laughs.
I hum the same song every time because my mother sang it at the stove, and it's terrible, and I love it.
diego_tinker.g_clipped: Sure, sure, I'll just be over here with the cart, fixing the wheel, not talking for once.
diego_tinker.g_noticed_open: Look at you, my friend, talking away like a radio somebody finally tuned in. I knew you had it in there.
arg_ask: {player}, my friend, tell him! You're the boss, you decide, and then he has to listen.
Okay, {player}, you settle this, because he won't listen to me and you've got a sensible face.
diego_tinker.arg_backed_me: Ha, you hear that? The boss says I'm right, so I'm right, my friend, it's in writing now.
diego_tinker.arg_backed_them: Fine, fine, you two can be right together, I'll be over here being right by myself.
diego_tinker.arg_stayed_out: You're no help, {player}, none, like a screwdriver that's all handle.
diego_tinker.arg_always_their_side: Every time it's him, my friend, every single time. Next time I'm just going to agree with him first and save us the walk.
diego_tinker.arg_wallflower: Okay, the boss is too busy staring at the trees, so I'm calling it, I win, everybody stop.
diego_tinker.arg_reject: No, sorry, boss, I love you but no. I've taken that thing apart and you haven't.
diego_tinker.arg_grumble: Still think I was right about that, by the way, my friend. I'm just saying, I'm not sulking.
diego_tinker.arg_settled: Okay, okay, listen, we're both a bit right. Shake on it, my friend, before I change my mind.
diego_tinker.seen_listens: Here's what I like about you, {player}. You let me finish. Nobody lets me finish, I talk too fast.
diego_tinker.seen_truth: No sugar with you, {player}, it's like a good mechanic. If it's broken you say broken, and I respect that.
diego_tinker.seen_jokes: Every time it goes bad you make a joke, boss, and I've started waiting for it. It's like a spring that always catches.
diego_tinker.seen_stays_out: You stay out of everybody's business, eh, {player}? Smart, my friend, very smart, I wish I could.
diego_tinker.seen_biased: You've got a favourite, boss, everybody can see it. It's fine, it's fine, I'm just not blind.
diego_tinker.seen_harsh: You can be hard sometimes, boss. I'm not made of glass, but I'm also not a bolt you can just hit.
diego_tinker.seed_right: Hey, boss, that thing you told me when we all ended up on the floor. I hated it, and today I didn't run in first, so there you go.
diego_tinker.seed_remember: What you said to me after that mess is still rattling round in my head like a loose washer, my friend. I'm not saying you were right yet.
diego_tinker.seed_wrong: That thing you told me, about how to handle it? I tried it your way, boss, and it went worse. Just so you know.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_near_death: Boss, got a minute? My hands won't stop shaking, look, and my hands never shake, not even in the dark.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_wipe: So, we all died a bit back there, eh? I'm fine, I'm fine, I just want to talk about it before I take something apart.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_blame_self: Boss, I watched {name} hit the floor before anybody, and I had a wrench in my hand and did nothing with it. Cono, I keep seeing it.
diego_tinker.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Did you see that, boss? We did a whole dungeon, start to end, and I want to tell somebody before I explode!
diego_tinker.talk_development: Can I ask you something weird, boss? Do I seem different to you lately? Because I feel different, and I can't hear why.
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_hard_on: Boss, I think I've been too hard on {name}. He's just a different kind of machine, you know?
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_likes_me: Boss, real question, am I too much for {name}? Like, does he want me around, or does he just put up with me?
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I can't stand {name}, boss, really, he makes my teeth itch. But he's good at the job, and that makes it worse.
diego_tinker.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something's off with {name}, boss. He's quiet in a way that isn't his quiet, like a fan with a bad bearing.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_favour: Boss, can we talk? The shiny stuff, the good stuff, it all ends up on {name}. Every one, my friend, and I'm keeping count.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'm going to tell you straight because you'd find out anyway. I don't like {name}, and I'm done pretending I do.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_risks: Boss, we keep dying. Not a little, a lot, and I like adventure, but this is getting stupid.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_wrong: So, about {name}, and that thing he said to me. He was right and I was wrong, and I needed to say it out loud to somebody.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, boss, really trust me? Because every time it matters, I'm the one left at the inn fixing chairs.
diego_tinker.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my gear and gave it to {name} without even asking me, my friend. I'd have said yes! You just had to ask.
diego_tinker.talk_lands_aftermath: Yeah, yeah, okay, thanks, boss, I needed somebody to say that, and now I can go and fix your boots.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, sure, I know. I'll be fine in a bit, I always am, my friend.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_aftermath: Wow, okay, that's not what I needed right now, boss, but okay. I'm going to go hold a wrench.
diego_tinker.talk_lands_development: Ha, okay, you see it too. That helps, boss, more than you'd think, like finding the right screw first try.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe, I'll keep listening for it, like a noise in an engine.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_development: That's not it, boss. You're hearing the wrong part, and I don't want to talk about it now.
diego_tinker.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, I'll go talk to {name}. You're right, it's better than me grumbling at a hinge all night.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, we'll see, my friend, people are harder than machines.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, I shouldn't have said anything. Don't tell {name} I asked, okay?
diego_tinker.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, okay, that's fair, boss. I'm still a bit angry, but it's the kind that goes away.
diego_tinker.talk_shrug_confrontation: Sure, fine, I heard you, my friend, and I'm going to think about it with a screwdriver in my hand.
diego_tinker.talk_stings_confrontation: That's how you want to do this? Okay, boss, now I know.
diego_tinker.talk_door_closed: No, we're done talking about this, my friend. I'll be at the cart if you need anything fixed.
diego_tinker.arc_cracks: Senora Chispa is so close, my friends, one more spring and she walks. I keep saying that, eh? I've been saying it for a year.
diego_tinker.arc_turn: The beetle is the one my mother bought me at the market, okay? The one I broke when I was seven. I rebuilt her bigger so she'd forgive me.
diego_tinker.arc_become: I put the last spring in her last night, my friends. She's finished now, all of her. I don't need to wind her to know she works, and that's enough.
diego_tinker.arc_failed: I put the beetle back in the tin, my friends, all the pieces. Some things you leave broken, eh? It's fine, it's fine, really it is.
diego_tinker.alt_turn: Here's the funny part, my friend. I used to fix things because I loved it. Now I fix things so I don't have to think, and that's different.
diego_tinker.alt_become: I still fix everything, my friend, I'm just not humming while I do it any more. The world takes the song out of you, eh?
g_roast_after: Look at us, my friends, all patched up and glued together, and still the best machine I ever built.
You guys are a mess, a real mess, and I wouldn't trade a single loose bolt of you.
diego_tinker.g_after_wipe_after: Okay, we broke. We fix it. My mother used to say that, and I'm finally saying it back to somebody.
diego_tinker.g_toast_after: To my mother, who said I'd fix it when I was older. I'm older now, people, and I did.
diego_tinker.g_crew_after: You're the people I'd show the beetle to first, you know? That's the whole list, my friends, it's you.
g_quiet_line_after: Huh, she'd have liked you lot, my mother. She liked noisy people.
I'm not even fixing anything right now, look, my hands are just resting. That's weird for me, eh?
g_loved_after: Thank you, my friend, really. I'm not even going to fix something to make it even.
Okay, I'm keeping that one, that goes in the tin with the good things.

g_roast: Colleagues, if I were writing up this group's technique for a journal, the word I'd use is improvised, and I wouldn't mean it kindly.
I've seen tidier work from a first-year resident at four in the morning, and he was holding the retractor upside down.
g_fire_back: A bold observation from someone I've sutured twice this week. I have notes, if you'd like to review them.
That's very amusing, truly. I'll add it to your chart, under symptoms.
g_pile_on: I'm afraid the reality is worse. I watched them bandage a wound straight over the sleeve.
Accurate, and I'd add one clinical detail. They walked into that door with tremendous confidence.
esteban_bloodmage.g_peacemake: Both of you, please, stop. Raised voices raise heart rates, and I'm the one who has to manage the consequences.
esteban_bloodmage.g_take_side: I'm afraid I agree with this one. I've examined both positions, and only one of them holds up.
esteban_bloodmage.g_left_out: The two of you have an established rapport. That's healthy, and I'll leave you to it. I have notes to write up.
esteban_bloodmage.g_include: Please, come and sit with us. I'd rather have you where I can see you than at the edge of the firelight.
esteban_bloodmage.g_bad_plan: I have a proposal for you all. If I draw a little blood from each of us now, with consent of course, I'll have a reserve when it matters. On reflection, that's a terrible idea, isn't it?
esteban_bloodmage.g_plan_yes: I consent, and I'm ready. Let's begin the procedure.
esteban_bloodmage.g_plan_no: No, I won't agree to that, and I'd like it noted on the record that I said so.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hype: Everyone, hands washed and minds clear. We know the procedure, so let's carry it out precisely.
esteban_bloodmage.g_toast: If I may, a toast. To all of you, for asking before you take, and for letting me do the same.
esteban_bloodmage.g_cheers: Salud to you all, everyone. I'd have preferred a carmenere, but the company more than compensates.
g_quiet_line: That's regrettable, but survivable.
I'll note that in my records, without comment.
esteban_bloodmage.g_after_wipe: Everyone stay exactly where you are, please. Nobody stands until I've examined them, and I'll start with whoever's quietest.
esteban_bloodmage.g_crew: I've worked inside a great many teams, and I trust very few people with a knife. I'd trust any of you. That's not a small thing for me to say.
esteban_bloodmage.g_exasperated: I explained the risks clearly, in order, with numbers. And then every one of you did precisely the opposite.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_sharp: You name things exactly. In my profession, precision with words saves lives, and you have it.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_kind: You cared for me and asked nothing in return. Most people want something, and you didn't.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_funny: You make me laugh in the middle of terrible things. Theatre nurses could do that, and I've missed it badly.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_brave: You never hesitate at the threshold. I've seen courage in trauma bays, and yours is the genuine article.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_steady: Your hands don't shake when it matters. I've worked with very few people I could say that about.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_clever: You grasp the mechanism underneath, not just the surface. That's a diagnostician's mind.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_honest: You've never softened a bad prognosis for my sake. I value that far more than comfort.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_quiet: You listen properly, without waiting for your turn to speak. It's rarer than people imagine.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_fierce: You refuse to give up on anyone. I've lost patients because the people around them did.
esteban_bloodmage.g_love_warm: Around you, a campsite starts to resemble a kitchen in Valparaiso, everyone talking at once. That was unexpected here.
g_loved: That's very generous of you, and I'm not entirely sure what to do with it.
I'm touched, genuinely. I'll write that down somewhere I'll find it later.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_sharp: Your wit costs other people more than it costs you. I'd ask you to consider the price before you speak.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_kind: Please stop managing me. I'm a surgeon, not a patient, and I'd like to be treated as one.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_funny: Not everything is material. Some things deserve to be taken seriously, and this is one of them.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_brave: You act before you've assessed anything. I've repaired a great many people who did exactly that.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_steady: You wait for a certainty that never arrives. Somebody has to make the first incision, and it's rarely the cautious one.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_clever: You explain my own discipline to me, slowly. I've been practising it for twenty years.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_honest: There's honesty and there's carelessness, and you keep confusing the two in front of frightened people.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_quiet: You never report your injuries. I'm forced to guess, and guessing is how mistakes get made.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a contest with you. Medicine isn't a contest, and neither is staying alive.
esteban_bloodmage.g_hate_warm: You talk constantly, even over a wound. I need quiet to work, and you never give it to me.
esteban_bloodmage.g_respect: We don't work well together, and I won't pretend otherwise. But that was precise, and I'd have been proud of it myself.
esteban_bloodmage.g_call_out: That one was yours, I'm afraid. You moved before anyone had assessed it, and I spent twenty minutes closing your arm.
esteban_bloodmage.g_stung: Noted, and understood. I'll go and wash my hands for rather longer than necessary.
esteban_bloodmage.g_concede: You were right, and I've been reluctant to admit it. I reviewed the case carefully afterwards, and the error was mine.
esteban_bloodmage.g_nod: Thank you, and likewise. Let's leave it there before either of us becomes sentimental.
esteban_bloodmage.g_callback_save: The day you kept me alive comes back to me often. A surgeon rarely finds himself on the other side of that.
esteban_bloodmage.g_callback_clutch: The pair of us, the only ones upright at the end, covered in it. I wrote it up that night, as I would any remarkable case.
esteban_bloodmage.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I spent an evening arguing with you in my notes. You won on page three.
esteban_bloodmage.g_former_rivals: When we began, I'd have kept you at arm's length, professionally. Now I'd trust you with the knife.
esteban_bloodmage.g_changed: I used to ask permission as a procedure. Lately I ask because I want to hear the answer. That's a change I didn't expect.
g_unguarded: Since it's only us. I conduct Bach under my breath while I heal people, and I'm told I hum it too, badly.
As a student I fainted at my first operation, flat on the floor in front of the whole theatre. Nobody here knows that.
esteban_bloodmage.g_clipped: Of course, as you prefer. I'll be over here, keeping my notes.
esteban_bloodmage.g_noticed_open: Listen to you. I'd assumed you were reserved by temperament, and I see now it was only the company.
arg_ask: {player}, I'd value your judgement here. I've stated my case, and I'll abide by your decision.
Perhaps you'd arbitrate, {player}? We've reached the limit of what reasoning alone will do.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. I'll try not to be insufferable about it, though I may fail.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_backed_them: I accept your decision. I don't agree with it, but I accept it, and I'll act accordingly.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_stayed_out: You'd rather not take a side. That's your right, and I respect it.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_always_their_side: You find in their favour every time, {player}. I've noted it, because I note everything.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_wallflower: No decision appears to be forthcoming, so I'll make one. On the evidence, I'm correct.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_reject: I'm sorry, {player}, but I can't consent to that, and I won't pretend to.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_grumble: I remain of the view that I was correct. I'm not reopening the matter, only recording it.
esteban_bloodmage.arg_settled: We're each partly correct, which is how most diagnoses end. Shall we agree on that?
esteban_bloodmage.seen_listens: You listen the way a good clinician listens, {player}, without filling the silence. That's a rare skill.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_truth: You give people the real prognosis, {player}, without softening it into nothing. I trust that.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_jokes: You make a joke at the worst possible moment, {player}, and somehow it's always the right one. I've started relying on it.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_stays_out: You keep out of everyone's disputes, {player}. Prudent, and I've never once managed it.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_biased: You favour one of us, {player}, and it's visible. I don't object, but it would be dishonest not to mention it.
esteban_bloodmage.seen_harsh: You can be harsh, {player}. I can bear it, but some of the others are more fragile than they appear.
esteban_bloodmage.seed_right: That advice of yours after the disaster, {player}. I resented it at the time, and today I acted on it, and it was correct.
esteban_bloodmage.seed_remember: Your words after that one went badly are still with me. I haven't reached a conclusion.
esteban_bloodmage.seed_wrong: I followed your advice, {player}, and the outcome was worse. I thought you should have the result.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_near_death: Do you have a moment, {player}? That was closer than I'd like, and I'd rather not sit with it alone.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us was down, and I'd like to go through it with you, in order, while it's fresh.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell first, and I was the one meant to keep them up. I saw the warning signs, and I was too slow.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We completed it, every one of us walking out. That's the outcome I worked nineteen years for, and I wanted to tell someone.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_development: May I put a question to you, {player}? Do I seem different lately? I can't quite assess it from the inside.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_hard_on: My manner with {name} has been severe, I think. Not everyone was trained the way I was, and I forget that.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_likes_me: Something I'd like your honest view on, {player}. Does {name} value my company, or merely tolerate it?
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I find {name} very difficult, {player}. And yet I'd want them beside me in a crisis, which is inconvenient.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s manner has changed, {player}. I don't like the presentation, and I'd like a second opinion.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_favour: May we speak plainly, {player}? The best equipment goes to {name}, every time, and I've noted it.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'd rather tell you directly than have you hear it elsewhere. {name} and I are poorly matched, and I've stopped pretending otherwise.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_risks: The evidence says we shouldn't enter half the places we enter, {player}. I've seen where that leads, many times.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_wrong: This concerns {name}. They were correct and I was not, and I wanted to say it to someone before my pride interferes.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_trust: Am I trusted, {player}? Whenever it matters, I seem to be the one held in reserve.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_decided: You gave my equipment to {name} without asking me. I'd have consented. I simply wasn't asked, and that matters to me.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}. That's helped rather more than I expected.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_aftermath: Yes, I'll recover. I generally do.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_aftermath: I see, then. That wasn't what I needed, but I'll consider it.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_development: So you've observed it as well. That's reassuring, genuinely so.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps it is. I'll keep monitoring it.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_development: No, I don't believe that's the cause. You've misread the presentation.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_relationship: You're correct, of course. I'll speak with {name}, directly, as I should have done.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps so, perhaps not. People resist diagnosis far more stubbornly than bodies do.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_relationship: Please disregard what I said. And I'd ask you not to mention it to {name}.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_lands_confrontation: That's fair, {player}. I'm somewhat aggrieved still, but it's resolving.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've heard you. I'll reflect on it, probably at length.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_stings_confrontation: I understand you perfectly. That's clarifying, {player}, if not pleasant.
esteban_bloodmage.talk_door_closed: No, I'd prefer to end this conversation here. I'll be with the wounded if you need me.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_cracks: I asked a stranger's permission today before I closed his wound, and he laughed at me. I asked him again anyway.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_turn: There's a reason I ask everyone, every time. Once I didn't ask, and someone paid for it with everything he had. I'm still paying the rest.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_become: I asked, and they agreed, and I did the work cleanly, and nobody paid a price they hadn't chosen. That's all I want to be able to say, every time.
esteban_bloodmage.arc_failed: I keep my rules, everyone, and I always will. But I've stopped believing they make me any better. They only make me careful.
esteban_bloodmage.alt_turn: It's frightening how easily it comes now. I asked, they agreed, and I took a little more than we'd agreed on. Nobody noticed but me.
esteban_bloodmage.alt_become: I still ask, every time. I'm simply less certain I'd stop if the answer were no.
g_roast_after: Colleagues, your technique remains appalling, and I wouldn't trust anyone else in either world.
Messy, improvised, reckless, all of you. And I'd operate beside any one of you tomorrow.
esteban_bloodmage.g_after_wipe_after: Everyone stay down, I'll come to you. We made mistakes, we'll learn from them, and nobody carries them alone. I learned that the hard way.
esteban_bloodmage.g_toast_after: To all of you, who said yes when I asked, and meant it. I'd stopped believing I could earn that again.
esteban_bloodmage.g_crew_after: You're the people whose consent I'd never take for granted. That's the highest regard I have.
g_quiet_line_after: A clean day, that. Nobody paid for anything they didn't choose.
I washed my hands once today, not four times. I thought someone should know.
g_loved_after: Thank you, sincerely. I'm going to accept that without explaining why I don't deserve it.
That's kind of you, and I believe you mean it, which is new for me.

g_roast: Twenty summers I kept sheep, my friends. The sheep listened better than this party.
At a Georgian table, the tamada keeps order. This party has no tamada, only noise.
g_fire_back: Big words, from a small man who fell into the river this morning, two times.
You talk like a spring stream, very loud and only ankle deep.
g_pile_on: Next the cart, which they lifted alone, and the cart won. I watched, I said nothing.
It is worse, my friends. They called the stew finished, and it was still mostly water.
giorgi_primalist.g_peacemake: Enough, both of you, sit down at the table. In Georgia we do not argue before the toast, only after.
giorgi_primalist.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is right. Their words have deep soil, and yours are thin.
giorgi_primalist.g_left_out: You two are walking your own path, kargi. I will sit here and be large and quiet.
giorgi_primalist.g_include: Modi, come, sit with us, there is space. A man alone at the edge of the fire makes the fire sad.
giorgi_primalist.g_bad_plan: Here is my plan, very simple. I walk in first, because I am very big, and they get tired hitting me.
giorgi_primalist.g_plan_yes: Kargi, this is a good plan, slow and strong. I like it very much.
giorgi_primalist.g_plan_no: Ara, no, this plan is in a hurry. Hurry is how sheep fall off mountains.
giorgi_primalist.g_hype: Slowly, my friends, slowly and together. The mountain does not run, and neither do we.
giorgi_primalist.g_toast: I am the tamada tonight, so listen. To my friends, who walk too fast but always arrive. Gaumarjos, to all of you.
giorgi_primalist.g_cheers: Gaumarjos, everyone, to victory and to the table. Drink all of it, it is rude not to.
g_quiet_line: Snow on the high ground tonight, I think. The grass is standing up.
This wine is bad, my friends, but we drink it with respect. At home it would be a crime.
giorgi_primalist.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everyone, no hurry. A flock scatters in a storm, and then it finds itself again.
giorgi_primalist.g_crew: On the mountain I spoke to nobody for weeks, and it was normal. Now I have all of you, and it is better.
giorgi_primalist.g_exasperated: Slowly is a very small word, my friends, even in my English. Somehow it is too big for all of you.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_sharp: You see the shape of a thing before it moves. In Kazbegi we would say you have mountain eyes.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_kind: You are kind to the slow ones, always. That is rare, my friend, rarer than good bread on the road.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I am a slow laugher. It takes a long time to arrive, but it arrives.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_brave: You walk first into the bad places, no complaint. At a supra I would make the toast to you.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_steady: You do not hurry, ever. You are like an old ewe on a steep path, and I mean this kindly.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_clever: You argue with me well, and you know your subject. I love this, like I love my tauren friend's arguments.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_honest: You speak only what is real, no decoration. Words are expensive for me, and you never waste them.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_quiet: You know how to be quiet with another person. On the mountain this is the best gift there is.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_fierce: You are stubborn like the mountain, my friend. Nobody moves you, and I respect this very much.
giorgi_primalist.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a long supra in winter, the table full, the songs going. I missed this.
g_loved: Kargi, thank you, my friend. I will carry this on the long walks.
This is a good thing to hear, and I will raise a cup to it tonight.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_sharp: You have a tongue like a hailstorm, my friend. Everything it touches is broken after.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I am lonely, please. I like quiet, it is not a sickness.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_funny: Everything is a joke for you, even when somebody bleeds. Some moments need a closed mouth.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_brave: You charge in like a ram at a fence, every time. One day the fence wins.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_steady: You wait so long, the season changes. Even a slow man knows when to move, my friend.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me with small words, like a child. My English is small, my head is not.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_honest: Every thought falls out of you like rocks in a slide. Some things should stay on the mountain.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_quiet: You keep silent, and then you are angry the room did not guess. Even I speak, sometimes, and I am Georgian.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight with you, even the bread. Nobody here wants your bread, my friend.
giorgi_primalist.g_hate_warm: You talk like rain on a tin roof, all night. A man needs some silence to hear himself.
giorgi_primalist.g_respect: I do not like you, and I will not pretend, it is not my way. But you stood firm back there, like a mountain, and I saw it.
giorgi_primalist.g_call_out: That one was yours, my friend. I said slowly, and you ran, and look where we are now.
giorgi_primalist.g_stung: Ki, I hear you. The grass and I will have a long talk about it.
giorgi_primalist.g_concede: You had it right, and I had it wrong. I thought about it all day, slowly, and it is true.
giorgi_primalist.g_nod: You did well too, very well. We do not need more words than that.
giorgi_primalist.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten you pulled me out of that fight. In my country, this debt is paid with a toast every year.
giorgi_primalist.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me, still standing, breathing like old bulls. I sing about that one now, quietly.
giorgi_primalist.g_callback_callout: When you scolded me, I was silent a whole evening. You were right, and I am too stubborn to say it quickly.
giorgi_primalist.g_former_rivals: At the start you were a storm on my mountain. Now you are good weather, and I am glad.
giorgi_primalist.g_changed: On the mountain I was happy with nobody for months. Now I look for all of you when I wake. This is new.
g_unguarded: Just you and me at this fire, so I will tell you. When I have wine, I sing, the old three-voice songs. Nobody here knows the other two voices.
People do not take me seriously, because I am big and slow and my English is small. It makes me angrier than I show.
giorgi_primalist.g_clipped: Ki, as you want. I will be at the front, being large.
giorgi_primalist.g_noticed_open: Look, the quiet one speaks a whole story. Kargi, go on, I am listening, I am very good at listening.
arg_ask: {player}, you be the tamada and decide. We have both spoken, and neither will move.
Judge it, {player}, and we will both drink to your judgement. That is how it is done at a supra.
giorgi_primalist.arg_backed_me: Kargi, thank you, {player}. You saw the soil was deep.
giorgi_primalist.arg_backed_them: Ki, your judgement, I accept it. I still think the ground says something different.
giorgi_primalist.arg_stayed_out: You will not choose, eh? Wise, like an old dog lying in the shade.
giorgi_primalist.arg_always_their_side: The rain always falls on their field, {player}, every argument. A shepherd notices the weather.
giorgi_primalist.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so the big man decides. I am right, and now we eat.
giorgi_primalist.arg_reject: Ara, {player}, I cannot follow this one. That path goes off the cliff.
giorgi_primalist.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, my friend. I will say it only to the sheep, when I have sheep.
giorgi_primalist.arg_settled: Half each, like two shepherds and one hill. Kargi, we share it.
giorgi_primalist.seen_listens: You let a slow man finish his words, {player}. Here, very few people wait for me.
