marcus_stormbringer.g_love_clever: You understand things properly, how they work underneath. Do you know how lovely it is to talk to somebody like that?
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_honest: You've never once dressed up a bad forecast for me. I can't tell you how much that means to someone like me.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_quiet: You actually listen. I talk a lot, sorry, I know I do, and you just let me, and I notice.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_fierce: You don't give up, ever. I wish I'd had a bit of that back when I was writing warnings nobody read.
marcus_stormbringer.g_love_warm: You make a camp feel like my sister's kitchen on a Sunday, loud and warm and everyone talking over each other. I love that.
g_loved: Oh, gosh, okay, thank you, I'll just stand over there and look at a cloud until my face goes back to normal.
That's very kind, sorry, I'm not good at this part. Thank you, really, I mean it.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_sharp: Everything has to have an edge with you, doesn't it? I've had enough of people who think cynical is the same as clever.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_kind: Please stop fussing, I'm fine, I've been fine for years. I'm a forecaster, not a patient.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_funny: Not everything's a joke. Some things are warnings, and the joke is how people ignore them.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_brave: You charge in without checking the conditions. I've seen what happens to people who do that, and it's in my data.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_steady: You want to wait and see, every time. Waiting and seeing is how I watched a lot of things go wrong.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_clever: You explain things I already know, slowly, and I've got a degree in atmospheric physics. Sorry, but I do.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_honest: There's honest and there's careless, and you keep landing on the wrong side of that line.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_quiet: You saw it coming and you didn't say a thing. I've spent my whole career trying to get people to say something.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_fierce: It's not a competition, it's never been a competition, and you keep turning it into one.
marcus_stormbringer.g_hate_warm: You talk straight over the warnings, every single one. And I'm saying that as somebody who talks a great deal.
marcus_stormbringer.g_respect: We don't get on, and I won't pretend we do. But you read that fight perfectly, and I've rarely seen a better call.
marcus_stormbringer.g_call_out: That was on you, and I think you know it. I gave the warning, clear as anything, and you went in regardless.
marcus_stormbringer.g_stung: Okay, sorry, yeah, message received. I'll be over there, taking a reading of nothing in particular.
marcus_stormbringer.g_concede: I've been avoiding saying this, but you had it right back there. I went through my notes twice, and you were right, and I'm sorry.
marcus_stormbringer.g_nod: Thank you, and the same to you, really. Let's not make it a big weather event.
marcus_stormbringer.g_callback_save: I still think about when you pulled me out of that mess. I'd already written my own forecast, and you changed it.
marcus_stormbringer.g_callback_clutch: The two of us, still upright at the end, completely soaked and laughing. I wrote it in my notes that night, you know.
marcus_stormbringer.g_callback_callout: The time you told me off, I filled four pages of notes arguing with you. You were still right on page five.
marcus_stormbringer.g_former_rivals: At the start, I'd have filed you under unreliable conditions. Now I'd trust your read on anything.
marcus_stormbringer.g_changed: I used to say everything three times and hope somebody caught it once. Lately I just say it, and people listen. It's very strange.
g_unguarded: Okay, confession, I name the storms. Privately, in my notes. The one last week was called Gerald, and he was a menace.
I chased tornadoes in a Corolla as a student, badly. Once I drove into a ditch watching one, and I've never told anyone that.
marcus_stormbringer.g_clipped: Mm, sure, fine, whatever you think. I'll watch the sky.
marcus_stormbringer.g_noticed_open: Listen to you! You've been holding all that back, haven't you? Please, keep going.
arg_ask: {player}, sorry, could you settle this? I've explained it four times, and I'm starting to sound like I did at work.
Okay, {player}, you decide. I've laid out the evidence, and I'll accept your forecast, I promise.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_backed_me: Oh, thank you, thank you! Sorry, I'm not gloating, I'm just very used to the other outcome.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_backed_them: Okay, I'll accept that. I still think the data was on my side, but I'll accept it.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_stayed_out: You're staying out of it? Fair enough, sorry, I know I can be a lot.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_always_their_side: It's their side again, {player}, it's always their side. I've started keeping a tally, which I realise is very me.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_wallflower: Well, nobody's going to call it, so I will. Based on the evidence, I'm right, sorry, but I am.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_reject: No, sorry, {player}, I can't go along with that one. I've seen how this forecast ends.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_grumble: I stand by my reading on that one, if anybody's still keeping track. I've got notes, if anybody's interested.
marcus_stormbringer.arg_settled: Okay, we're both partly right, which is actually how most forecasts work. Shake on it?
marcus_stormbringer.seen_listens: You listen the first time, {player}. I spent fifteen years saying everything three times, and you just hear it.
marcus_stormbringer.seen_truth: You give people the hard news, {player}, and you don't soften it into nothing. I wish I'd worked with you.
marcus_stormbringer.seen_jokes: When things are grimmest you crack a joke, {player}. I used to think that was avoidance, and now I think it's a kind of forecasting.
marcus_stormbringer.seen_stays_out: You stay out of the arguments, {player}. Very sensible, and I've never once managed it.
marcus_stormbringer.seen_biased: There's someone you favour, {player}, and it shows up in the data. Sorry, I notice patterns, it was my job.
marcus_stormbringer.seen_harsh: You can be quite harsh, {player}. I can take it, I've had worse from managers, but some of the others can't.
marcus_stormbringer.seed_right: What you told me after that mess, {player}, I didn't want to hear it. Today I acted on it, and it worked.
marcus_stormbringer.seed_remember: I keep coming back to what you said after that one went wrong. I've written it down, but I haven't decided about it yet.
marcus_stormbringer.seed_wrong: I tried it your way, {player}, and it went worse. I've got notes on it, if you want them.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_near_death: Have you got five minutes, {player}? That one was close, and my hands still won't stop shaking.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_wipe: So, we all went down back there. Could we talk it through? I need to understand what happened before I can put it down.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I felt the pressure change before {name} went down, and I didn't say it loud enough, not again.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, start to finish, every one of us! Sorry, I need to tell somebody or I'm going to burst.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_development: Could I run something past you, {player}? Do I seem different lately? Because I feel different, and I can't quite read it.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been rough with {name}, I think. Not everyone's spent a career being ignored, and I keep forgetting that.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_relationship_likes_me: Honest question, {player}, does {name} actually like having me around? Or do I just talk too much?
marcus_stormbringer.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I are a bad mix, {player}, sorry, warm front meets cold front. But they're very good at what they do, which is extremely annoying.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s gone quiet lately, {player}, the sort of quiet that comes right before weather, and I don't like the look of it.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_favour: Could we talk, {player}? The good gear keeps going to {name}. Every time, and I've noticed, because I notice everything.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'd rather say this to your face than have it reach you secondhand. {name} and I don't get on, and I've stopped pretending we do.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep walking into things the forecast says not to, {player}. I've seen where that ends, and I don't want to see it again.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_wrong: This is about {name}, sorry. Their read was right and mine was wrong, and I needed to tell somebody before I talk myself out of it.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust my judgement, {player}? Because when the big fights come round, I'm the one left behind watching the sky.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear went to {name} and nobody so much as mentioned it to me. I'd have agreed straight away, I really would. I just like being consulted.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_lands_aftermath: Okay, thank you, that actually helps. I think I can put it down now.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, sure, I'll be alright in a bit. I usually am.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_stings_aftermath: Oh, okay, that's not what I needed right now. I'll go and look at the sky.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_lands_development: So you've seen it too, then. That's a relief, it really is.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_shrug_development: Maybe it is, maybe it isn't. I'll keep watching it, like any system that hasn't made up its mind.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, sorry. You're reading the wrong front.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_lands_relationship: You're right, I'll go and talk to {name}. Better than writing four pages of notes about it.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, we'll see. People are much harder to forecast than weather.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_stings_relationship: Please, can we pretend I never brought it up? And keep it between us, not {name}.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, {player}. The front's moving through, I can feel it easing already.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, I've heard you. I'll think about it, probably at length, probably in writing.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, okay, so that's how it is. I've been here before, {player}.
marcus_stormbringer.talk_door_closed: No, sorry, I'm finished with this conversation. I'll be outside, watching the sky.
marcus_stormbringer.arc_cracks: Something odd happened back there. I said it was coming, once, quietly, and everybody moved. I'm still not sure what to do with that.
marcus_stormbringer.arc_turn: Fifteen years I said the right thing and nothing changed, so I stopped saying it loudly. Out here, you listened, and I don't think I've stopped shaking.
marcus_stormbringer.arc_become: Pressure's dropping, storm in ten minutes, get under cover. I said it once, and once was enough. That's all I ever wanted.
marcus_stormbringer.arc_failed: I'll keep giving the warnings, everyone. I've just stopped expecting anybody to hear them, and that's fine, it's fine.
marcus_stormbringer.alt_turn: I used to explain things because I loved it. Now I explain things because nobody listens, and I'm tired, and that's not the same thing.
marcus_stormbringer.alt_become: There's a storm coming in. You'll do whatever you do, and I'll be the one who said so.
g_roast_after: You lot still walk straight into every storm I warn you about, and I've never been prouder to be standing next to anyone.
Worst-listening, best team I've ever worked with. Well, you listen now, which is frankly unsettling.
marcus_stormbringer.g_after_wipe_after: Okay, we went down, and that's on all of us, the forecast included. Next time I'll say it sooner, and you'll hear it. You always do now.
marcus_stormbringer.g_toast_after: To everyone here, for hearing it the first time. You don't know what that's worth, and I'm not going to explain it, which tells you how much I mean it.
marcus_stormbringer.g_crew_after: You're the people who listened. That's the whole list, and it's a short list, and it's all of you.
g_quiet_line_after: That storm's passing now. I knew it would, and I didn't even have to say it three times.
Pressure's steady tonight. So am I, for once.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really. I'm going to remember that one, it's going in the good notes.
That means a lot, it does, and I won't dodge it with a cloud fact this time.

g_roast: Ten years on a bus in Santiago, cabros. The drunk ones at midnight walked straighter than this party.
Five people, one road, and everybody still gets off at the wrong stop. That is a talent, weon.
g_fire_back: Ya, very funny, from the one who fell asleep on watch two nights running.
Careful, I see everything from the front. I saw what you did with the map.
g_pile_on: And then they argued with a door. The door won, cachai.
It is worse, I counted. Three times the same wrong turn, same face every time.
matias_reaper.g_peacemake: Ya, stop, both of you, please. Sit, eat something, and talk when your voices are smaller.
matias_reaper.g_take_side: Sorry, but I am with this one. From the front, I saw it all, and they are right.
matias_reaper.g_left_out: You two are talking close, that is fine. I will watch the road for a while.
matias_reaper.g_include: Come, sit here, there is space. On my bus nobody stood when there was a seat.
matias_reaper.g_bad_plan: My plan is simple, cabros. We all run in, nobody watches the back, and we hope for the best.
matias_reaper.g_plan_yes: Ya, this is good, I like it. I take the front, so I see everybody.
matias_reaper.g_plan_no: No, weon, this plan is bad. Somebody falls in the gap, and nobody sees it happen.
matias_reaper.g_hype: Ya, cabros, stay close and keep your eyes open. I go first.
matias_reaper.g_toast: I do not talk much, so I will be short. To all of you, my regulars, who always get on.
matias_reaper.g_cheers: Salud, everybody, to your health. And somebody save me some bread.
g_quiet_line: That trader at the post was lying about the weight, by the way. I watched his hands.
Good morning for walking today, cold and clear. Like Santiago in winter, a little.
matias_reaper.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everybody, nobody rushes. First we count heads, then we breathe, then we try again.
matias_reaper.g_crew: On the bus I had forty faces every morning, and I knew them all. Now I have you. It is better, I think.
matias_reaper.g_exasperated: I said wait, I said watch the left, I even pointed. Chucha, and everybody went right.
matias_reaper.g_love_sharp: You see who is about to fall before they fall. On the bus, that was the whole job.
matias_reaper.g_love_kind: You give up your seat without anybody asking. On my bus, you would be my favourite passenger.
matias_reaper.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I am a quiet man. That is not easy, cachai.
matias_reaper.g_love_brave: You go in front and you do not make noise about it. That is the kind of brave I trust.
matias_reaper.g_love_steady: Your hands stay still in the worst moments. People like you keep a whole bus calm.
matias_reaper.g_love_clever: You understand things fast, before I finish explaining. That helps a man with slow English.
matias_reaper.g_love_honest: You say what is real, simple, with no extra. I can understand you always, and I like that.
matias_reaper.g_love_quiet: You give me time to find the next word. Not many people wait, and you always do.
matias_reaper.g_love_fierce: You do not give up, ever, even when it hurts. Puta, I admire that.
matias_reaper.g_love_warm: Sitting with you is like Sunday lunch at home, football on the television. I missed that feeling.
g_loved: Gracias, really, thank you. I do not have good words for this.
Ya, you will make me cry, weon, and I am at the front. Thank you, really.
matias_reaper.g_hate_sharp: You always find the soft place and push. On the bus I would put you off at the next stop.
matias_reaper.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I am okay, please, I am okay. I am only quiet, quiet is not sad.
matias_reaper.g_hate_funny: Not everything must be a joke. Sometimes we just watch and stay quiet.
matias_reaper.g_hate_brave: You charge with your eyes closed, every time. Somebody behind you always pays for it.
matias_reaper.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait and the moment leaves. Sometimes you just move, weon.
matias_reaper.g_hate_clever: You talk to me slowly, like I am stupid. My English is slow, my head is not.
matias_reaper.g_hate_honest: Everything in your head comes out loud, all of it. Some things you keep inside, cachai.
matias_reaper.g_hate_quiet: You keep your needs inside, then you are angry. Even I say something, sometimes.
matias_reaper.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight for you, even the bread. Nobody is fighting you for bread.
matias_reaper.g_hate_warm: You talk and talk about nothing, all day. My ears need a rest, please.
matias_reaper.g_respect: I do not like you much, and you know it. But you held the front back there, and I saw it.
matias_reaper.g_call_out: That one was yours, weon. I said wait, and you did not wait, and look.
matias_reaper.g_stung: Ya, I heard. I will walk a little, alone.
matias_reaper.g_concede: You had it right, and I had it wrong. I thought about it all day, and it is true.
matias_reaper.g_nod: You also, good work. We do not need to say more.
matias_reaper.g_callback_save: I did not forget you pulled me out of that fight. I do not forget faces, or what they do.
matias_reaper.g_callback_clutch: You and me, the last two still standing, both shaking. I think about that one a lot, cachai.
matias_reaper.g_callback_callout: When you told me off, I was angry all day. Then I understood you were right.
matias_reaper.g_former_rivals: At the start I did not trust you at all. Now I would stand in front of you every time.
matias_reaper.g_changed: My first year here I stopped talking completely. Now listen to me, talking all the time. It is strange.
g_unguarded: Just for you, then. On the bus I always got up for the grandmothers. Here I still look for a seat to give.
I am learning to read the writing here, slowly, from a woman at the trade post. Do not ask me why yet.
matias_reaper.g_clipped: Ya, fine, whatever you say. I will be in front.
matias_reaper.g_noticed_open: Look, a whole speech, and nobody stopped you. Ya, keep going, I like hearing it.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this one, please. I said my part, and they do not listen.

matias_reaper.arg_backed_me: Gracias, {player}, thank you. I knew you saw it too.
matias_reaper.arg_backed_them: Ya, fine, your choice. I still think I was right.
matias_reaper.arg_stayed_out: You do not choose, eh? Smart, very smart.
matias_reaper.arg_always_their_side: Always their side, {player}, every single argument. I notice, I notice everything.
matias_reaper.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I decide. I am right, and that is the end.
matias_reaper.arg_reject: Not that one, {player}, sorry. I saw how it ends, from the front.
matias_reaper.arg_grumble: I still think I was right. Quietly, one time, and then I stop.
matias_reaper.arg_settled: Half right each, okay, ya. We shake hands and keep walking.
matias_reaper.seen_listens: You wait for me to finish my sentence, {player}, always. Most people finish it for me, wrong.
matias_reaper.seen_truth: You say things straight, {player}, simple words. With my English, that is a big help.
matias_reaper.seen_jokes: On the worst days you find something funny, {player}. On the night buses the drivers did that, and it helped everybody.
matias_reaper.seen_stays_out: Other people's fights, you leave alone, {player}. You watch the whole bus, like a conductor.
matias_reaper.seen_biased: One person always gets the best seat, {player}. Everybody on the bus can see.
matias_reaper.seen_harsh: Your words are rough sometimes, {player}. I am okay, but some of them are softer.
matias_reaper.seed_right: What you told me after that bad fight, {player}, I did not like it. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
matias_reaper.seed_remember: I am still thinking about your words from that bad day. Slowly, like my English.
matias_reaper.seed_wrong: Your way did not work for me, {player}, it went worse. I only tell you, no problem.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I talk with you, {player}? That one was very close, and I do not say it to the others.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody went down, all of us at once. Sit with me, and we look at it step by step.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first one down, and I was at the front. From there I see everything, {player}, and I did not see that.
matias_reaper.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first stop to the last, everybody got off safe. On the bus, this was the best day.
matias_reaper.talk_development: Strange question, {player}. Do I seem different now? I talk more, and I do not know when it started.
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been hard with {name}, I think. My English is short, so it comes out hard.
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_likes_me: One honest answer, {player}. Is {name} happy I ride with you, or am I just the quiet one at the front to them?
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} makes me crazy, {player}, completely. But in a bad fight, I want them next to me.
matias_reaper.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something is wrong with {name}, {player}. Their face changed, like a regular having a bad week.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, straight. The best gear keeps landing with {name}, and everybody on this bus sees it.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it to your face, it is better. {name} and I do not get along, and I stop pretending.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_risks: We go into bad places with no exit, {player}, too often. I always take the front, but I want to come back.
matias_reaper.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name}, {player}, I was wrong. They saw it right and I did not, and I say it now before I get stubborn.

matias_reaper.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be okay, slowly. I always come back.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_aftermath: That is not what I needed to hear. I will walk alone a little.
matias_reaper.talk_lands_development: So you see it too, okay. Then it is real.
matias_reaper.talk_shrug_development: Maybe yes, maybe no. We will see later.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it, {player}. You read me wrong this time.
matias_reaper.talk_lands_relationship: Ya, that is fair. I will talk to {name}, carefully.
matias_reaper.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, I do not know. People are hard to read, even for me.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And nothing to {name}, okay?
matias_reaper.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that is fair, I accept. I am a little angry still, but it passes.
matias_reaper.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, I heard, {player}. Give me some time with it.
matias_reaper.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that is the answer. Now I know.
matias_reaper.talk_door_closed: No, enough of this one, please. I will be at the front.
matias_reaper.arc_cracks: Yesterday I told a whole story at the fire, start to end, and nobody had to wait for me. I surprised myself, {player}.
matias_reaper.arc_turn: My first year here I stopped talking because nothing was worth translating. Now I want to say things, every day, and it scares me a little.
matias_reaper.arc_become: I talk now, {player}, really talk, in my bad English and my good Spanish. There are things worth saying, and I want to say them while I can.
matias_reaper.arc_failed: It is easier to be quiet, I think. I will stay at the front and watch, and the words can wait.
matias_reaper.alt_turn: I said nothing for three days and nobody noticed, {player}. The quiet is comfortable again, and that is the dangerous part.
matias_reaper.alt_become: I am quiet again, mostly. I still watch everybody, but I do not say much now. It is easier this way.
g_roast_after: Still the worst passengers I ever had, cabros, and I would drive this route forever.
Late, loud, lost, all of you, and I would not change one face.
matias_reaper.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everybody, together, nobody stays on the floor. We fell, we get up, and this time I talk you through it.
matias_reaper.g_toast_after: To all of you, who waited for my words until they came back. I will not stop talking now, sorry.
matias_reaper.g_crew_after: This is my route now, you are my regulars, every stop. I know every face, and I like every face.
g_quiet_line_after: I told a joke at the fire today, in English, and they laughed. A good joke, also.
I said good morning to everybody today. Out loud, every one, like on the bus.
g_loved_after: Gracias, really, and this time I have the words. I like that very much.
Ya, thank you, and I believe you. That is new.

g_roast: Twenty-three years on a radar scope, everyone, and I never once watched five aircraft fly into the same mountain on purpose.
For the incident report, then. The party was cleared to wait, acknowledged the instruction, and charged anyway.
g_fire_back: Say again, please? I think I heard a criticism from the person who walked into the last ambush reading a map upside down.
Copy that, noted, and filed. Your own file is considerably thicker, by the way.
g_pile_on: To add to the sequence of events, they then tried the same door a second time. It remained a wall.
Correct, and the timeline is worse than that. I have it written down, if anyone wants the full account.
minh_chronomancer.g_peacemake: Stand by, both of you, please. One at a time, first the sequence of events, then the feelings, and nobody talks over anybody.
minh_chronomancer.g_take_side: Sorry, but this one has the correct picture. I have watched the whole sequence, and the timing supports them.
minh_chronomancer.g_left_out: The two of you are on a private frequency, which is fine. I will take the watch in the meantime.
minh_chronomancer.g_include: Come in and join us, there is room in the circle. Holding at the edge only burns fuel.
minh_chronomancer.g_bad_plan: Here is the proposed sequence. Everyone goes in at once, from every direction, with no separation at all, and we hope nothing collides.
minh_chronomancer.g_plan_yes: Copy, that plan works, and the sequence is sound. Cleared to proceed.
minh_chronomancer.g_plan_no: Negative, I cannot clear that one. Too many things happen at the same moment, and nobody can hold all of them.
minh_chronomancer.g_hype: All stations, listen up, please. Keep your separation, call your moves, and we go on my mark.
minh_chronomancer.g_toast: A short toast, in the right order. To all of you, who arrive late but always land safely.
minh_chronomancer.g_cheers: Mot hai ba, everyone, which means one, two, three. In Saigon we drink on three.
g_quiet_line: The sky is clear tonight, which is my favourite kind. Nothing up there needs me.
For your situational awareness, there is a patrol two ridges east. I am watching it.
minh_chronomancer.g_after_wipe: Everyone up, slowly, in your own time. First we confirm nobody is badly hurt, then we work out the sequence, then we fix it.
minh_chronomancer.g_crew: For twenty years I worked in a dark room, surrounded by people I only knew as voices. This is better, considerably.
minh_chronomancer.g_exasperated: I called the threat, I called it twice, I gave you the heading to avoid it. And every one of you flew straight into it.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_sharp: You see the conflict before it develops. In my old job, that was the whole skill.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_kind: You care for people who forget to care for themselves. I notice that, because I am one of them.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_funny: You made me laugh during a crisis, which my old supervisor would have reported. I am grateful, quietly.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_brave: You take the lead every single time, without a fuss. Somebody has to fly the lead aircraft, and it is always you.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_steady: Your voice never changes when it goes wrong. I spent twenty years learning that, and you simply have it.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_clever: You hold the whole picture in your head at once. I have met very few people who can do that.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_honest: You tell people exactly what is happening, no softening. A clear report saves lives, and yours are clear.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_quiet: You do not fill the silence, and neither do I. It is a very restful frequency to share.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_fierce: You hold your position whatever comes at you. That kind of discipline is rarer than courage.
minh_chronomancer.g_love_warm: Sitting near you is like the end of a long night shift, sunrise and a coffee. I had forgotten that feeling.
g_loved: Thank you, that is very kind. I will log it somewhere safe.
I am not sure how to respond to that, so I will simply say thank you, and mean it.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_sharp: You go for the weak point every time, and you enjoy it. That is not insight, that is cruelty with good timing.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_kind: You keep asking if I am all right. I am always all right, it is my job to be all right.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_funny: A joke in a crisis is fine, once. Every crisis, every time, means nobody is watching the scope.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_brave: You commit before you know the situation, and call it courage. Someone always has to clean up the conflict you create.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_steady: You wait for perfect information, and it never comes. At some point you have to give the instruction.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me slowly, as if I might not follow. I held forty aircraft in my head for twenty years.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_honest: You report everything, all of it, at once, with no order. True is not the same as useful.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_quiet: You never transmit, and then you are upset that nobody knew where you were. Call your position, please.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a competition with you, even who keeps watch. The watch is not a prize.
minh_chronomancer.g_hate_warm: You talk without a break, and the frequency is never clear. Some of us need it clear.
minh_chronomancer.g_respect: I do not enjoy your company, and I will not pretend to. But your timing back there was correct, and I respect correct timing.
minh_chronomancer.g_call_out: That one was yours, and I say it calmly. I called you to hold, and you did not hold, and the rest followed.
minh_chronomancer.g_stung: Copy, I have understood. I will take a moment on the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.g_concede: You had the correct picture, and I did not. I have reviewed it twice, and the error was mine.
minh_chronomancer.g_nod: You as well, that was well done. No need to discuss it further.
minh_chronomancer.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten that you brought me out of that fight. In my old job we called that a save, and we remembered them.
minh_chronomancer.g_callback_clutch: Only the pair of us left on our feet, breathing hard. I have replayed that sequence many times since.
minh_chronomancer.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I went quiet for a full day. Your call was correct, and I needed it.
minh_chronomancer.g_former_rivals: When we met, I had you down as a collision waiting to happen. Now I would trust you with my sector.
minh_chronomancer.g_changed: I used to keep every watch myself, all of them. Lately I let someone else take one, and I sleep through it.
g_unguarded: Just between us, then. I have not had one hour where nothing was my responsibility since 2003. I am starting to think the problem is me.
On the night shift we drank iced coffee so strong the spoon stood up. I still miss it, more than I miss most people.
minh_chronomancer.g_clipped: Copy that, as you wish. I will be on the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.g_noticed_open: Say again, please, because I liked that very much. A whole thought, transmitted clearly, in front of everyone.
arg_ask: {player}, would you make the call on this? We have both given our reports, and neither of us is moving.
You have control on this one, {player}. Give the instruction, and we will both follow it.
minh_chronomancer.arg_backed_me: Copy, thank you, {player}. That was the correct picture.
minh_chronomancer.arg_backed_them: Understood, your call, and I will follow it. I still think the sequence is wrong.
minh_chronomancer.arg_stayed_out: You decline the call, which is sometimes wise. I will not push.
minh_chronomancer.arg_always_their_side: Each time we disagree, {player}, the call goes to them. I have logged it, and I would rather mention it calmly.
minh_chronomancer.arg_wallflower: Nobody will make the call, so I will. My picture is correct, and we proceed on it.
minh_chronomancer.arg_reject: Negative, {player}, I cannot accept that instruction. I have watched that sequence end badly.
minh_chronomancer.arg_grumble: For the log, I still think my picture was correct. I will not raise it again.
minh_chronomancer.arg_settled: Half right each, then. Not tidy, but it lands safely, so I accept it.
minh_chronomancer.seen_listens: You let people give their whole report, {player}, before you answer. In my old job that was rare.
minh_chronomancer.seen_truth: You give people the clear picture, {player}, every time. Clear reports keep people alive.
minh_chronomancer.seen_jokes: When the pressure rises, you make people laugh, {player}. It lowers everyone's pulse, and that is a kind of control.
minh_chronomancer.seen_stays_out: You stay off the frequency when others are arguing, {player}. That is disciplined of you.
minh_chronomancer.seen_biased: One of us always gets priority, {player}. Everyone on the frequency can hear it.
minh_chronomancer.seen_harsh: You can be sharp with people, {player}. I am used to supervisors, but some of this group are not.
minh_chronomancer.seed_right: Your advice after that rough fight, {player}, I did not want it. I used it today, and it worked.
minh_chronomancer.seed_remember: I am still reviewing your report on that bad sequence. I have not reached a conclusion yet.
minh_chronomancer.seed_wrong: I tried your suggestion, {player}, and it went worse. For your information, that is all.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_near_death: Do you have a moment, {player}? That was a near miss, closer than I would report to the others.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, every one of us. Sit with me, and we will rebuild the sequence from the first contact.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped first, and I had the whole picture. I should have called it sooner, {player}.
minh_chronomancer.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, nobody lost, everyone home. That is the best possible outcome, and I do not say that often.
minh_chronomancer.talk_development: A strange question, {player}, forgive me. Have I changed since we met? I seem to sleep more, and I am suspicious of it.
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been strict with {name}. In a crisis I speak like a controller, and not everyone wants to be vectored.
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_likes_me: Your honest read, {player}. Does {name} value me, or do they only see the calm man who keeps watch?
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} tests my patience, {player}, badly. And yet if it all went wrong, I would want them in my sector.
minh_chronomancer.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s pattern has changed, {player}. They are holding somewhere they never hold, and I do not like it.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_favour: A short report, {player}, and a fair one. The good equipment keeps landing with {name}, and everyone can see the traffic.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will say it directly, since that is cleaner. {name} and I do not work well together, and I have stopped pretending.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep entering places with no exit and no plan, {player}. I will hold any sector you give me, but I want a way out.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was wrong, {player}. Their picture was correct and mine was not, and I want to report that before my pride edits it.
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_trust: A direct question, {player}, if I may. When it counts, I am kept back. Is that the plan, or your assessment of me?
minh_chronomancer.talk_confrontation_decided: My equipment was reassigned to {name}, and nobody told me. I would have released it myself, {player}, if anyone had asked.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be fine, I always am. Give me a moment to stand by.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_aftermath: That was not what I needed, I am afraid. I will go to the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.talk_lands_development: So you see it too. Good, then it is not only in my head.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not, the data is incomplete. I will keep watching.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_development: Negative, that is not it, {player}. You have the wrong picture.
minh_chronomancer.talk_lands_relationship: Copy, that is fair. I will raise it with {name}, gently.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_relationship: Possibly, possibly not. People are the hardest traffic to read.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_relationship: Then disregard my last, please. And not a word of it to {name}.
minh_chronomancer.talk_lands_confrontation: Understood, and that is fair. I am a little bruised, but it will pass.
minh_chronomancer.talk_shrug_confrontation: Copy that, {player}. I will review it on the ridge.
minh_chronomancer.talk_stings_confrontation: Understood, so that is the answer. Thank you for being clear.
minh_chronomancer.talk_door_closed: No, I would rather not reopen this one. I will be on watch if you need me.
minh_chronomancer.arc_cracks: Last night one of the young shamans offered to take my watch. I said no, of course. Then I lay awake wondering why.
minh_chronomancer.arc_turn: I keep every watch because I believe nothing holds without me. It has held without me a hundred times, {player}. I simply was not looking.
minh_chronomancer.arc_become: I gave the watch away last night, the whole night, and I slept. Nothing went wrong. You have control, I told them, and I meant it.
minh_chronomancer.arc_failed: I tried to hand it over, and I could not do it. The watch is mine, and it will stay mine. Somebody has to.
minh_chronomancer.alt_turn: I nodded off on the ridge yesterday, {player}, standing up. Twenty years with no hour off, and my body has started keeping its own count.
minh_chronomancer.alt_become: I am very tired, {player}, in a way sleep does not fix. I will keep going, but I am running on reserve now.
g_roast_after: Still the worst formation I have ever worked, everyone, and I would not trade a single one of you.
All of you on one frequency, talking over each other, and I have never felt calmer.
minh_chronomancer.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, and look at me. We went down together, we get up together, and nobody holds alone this time.
minh_chronomancer.g_toast_after: To all of you, who took the watch so I could sleep. You have no idea what that cost me to accept, and what it gave me.
minh_chronomancer.g_crew_after: This is my sector now, all of you, and I share the watch. I never thought I would say that.
g_quiet_line_after: Somebody else is on watch tonight, and I trust them. That is new for me, and very pleasant.
I slept seven hours last night, all of them in a row. I am almost embarrassed.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I believe you. I am getting better at that.
That is very kind, and I am keeping it, not filing it away.

g_roast: Mi gente, eleven years behind a chair in Santurce, and I never saw five heads of hair this badly managed, with love.
My aunts at a wedding are more organised than this party, and my aunts at a wedding are a natural disaster.
g_fire_back: Ay, mira quien habla, from the one whose hair looks like a startled chicken. With love, nene, with love.
That's cute, coming from someone who still can't tie a bootlace. I watched, papi, I see everything.
g_pile_on: And they asked the troll for directions, and the troll was also lost. Two lost people, one map, wepa.
It's worse, mi gente, I was there. They tried to dance at the inn, and the musicians stopped out of respect.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_peacemake: Oye, oye, both of you, sit down in my chair, figuratively. Tell me everything, one at a time, and nobody leaves angry.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_take_side: Sorry, mi amor, I'm with this one. I've heard the whole story twice, and they make more sense both times.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_left_out: Look at you two, a private little salon of your own, I love it. I'll go fix somebody's hair while I wait.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_include: Come, come, sit here, I saved you a seat. Nobody stands at the door in my shop, papi.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_bad_plan: My plan, mi gente, is beautiful. We walk in, I compliment everybody, they get confused, and we win.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_plan_yes: Wepa, that's a good plan, I love it. Clean lines, like a good fade.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_plan_no: Ay, no, mi amor, that plan is a bad haircut. Nobody can fix it once it's done.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hype: Okay, mi gente, chins up, look gorgeous, and stay together. Let's go make some noise.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_toast: A toast, a short one, my mother taught me manners. To mi gente, the best regulars any barber ever had.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_cheers: Salud, mi gente, and wepa, and somebody turn up the music.
g_quiet_line: The spirits are chatty tonight, by the way. One of them is very upset about a goat.
Somebody should find a radio in this world. I'd trade a week of dinners for one salsa song.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_after_wipe: Ay bendito, everybody, up slowly, slowly. Check your faces, check your hair, and then we talk about what happened.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_crew: In Santurce my shop was the whole neighbourhood, everybody in and out all day. Now this is my shop, mi gente, and you're the neighbourhood.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_exasperated: Patience, I begged, nicely, with a compliment attached. And every one of you ran in like it was a sale.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_sharp: You notice everything, mi amor, like my aunts at a wedding. Nobody gets anything past you, and I love it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_kind: You take care of people without anybody asking. My mother is like that, and so are you, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_funny: You make me laugh so hard I almost cut somebody's ear. That's the best compliment I have, nene.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_brave: You walk into the scary places with your head high. My little sister Yari walks like that, like she owns the street.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_steady: You never panic, mi amor, never. My father fixed buses like that, calm while everything rattled.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_clever: You understand people fast, faster than me, and I'm a professional. I'm a little jealous.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_honest: You tell people the truth, kindly, the way my mother does, with a plate of food in front of you first.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_quiet: You let a man talk, and you really listen. That's harder to find than a good barber in a small town. Free haircuts forever.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_fierce: You never give in, ever, and I admire it so much. Like my grandmother haggling at a market, nene.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_love_warm: Being with you is like a Saturday at the shop, radio loud, everybody laughing. I missed that so much.
g_loved: Ay, mi amor, stop, you'll ruin my good shirt with tears. Gracias, from the heart.
Wepa, that's beautiful, and I'm telling everybody you said it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_sharp: You always cut where it hurts, mi amor. In my shop, I'd politely show you the door, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I'm okay, papi, I'm always okay. I'm the one who asks, that's my job.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_funny: I love jokes, I live for jokes, but not when somebody's hurting. Then you listen.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_brave: You charge in with your eyes shut, and somebody else always pays. Brave is nice, careless is not.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_steady: You think and think and the moment walks out the door. Sometimes you just dance, nene, even badly.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me slowly, like I'm a kid. I ran my own business for eleven years, mi amor.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_honest: You say every single thing in your head, with no kindness in it. Truth needs a little conditioner, papi.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_quiet: You never tell anyone what's wrong, and a quiet room makes me nervous. Talk to me, please, I'm begging.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, even the bread. Nobody's taking your bread, relax.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_hate_warm: And I talk a lot, everybody knows it, but you talk even more. Give the rest of us a turn, mi amor.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_respect: We don't get along, papi, and that's okay. But you stood firm in that fight, and I respect that, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_call_out: That one was yours, nene, I'm sorry. I said wait, and you didn't, and look at the mess.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_stung: Okay, okay, I hear you. The spirits and I need a little chat.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_concede: Your read was right, mi amor, and mine was wrong. It sat on me all day like a bad haircut, and it's true.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_nod: You too, papi, beautiful work. We don't need to make a fiesta of it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_callback_save: I didn't forget you pulled me out of that fight. Arroz con gandules for life, nene, if I ever find the gandules.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me left standing, sweating like it's August in San Juan. I tell that story to everybody who sits down.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_callback_callout: When you told me off, I was quiet for a whole hour, which for me is a lifetime. You were right, mi amor.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to give you a terrible haircut. Now you get a seat at my mother's table, and that's the highest honour I have.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_changed: Three times somebody offered me a building for a real shop. Lately I wonder why I said no every time.
g_unguarded: Just us two, mi amor, so here it is. Don Beni came every Tuesday for nineteen years and never once needed a haircut. He needed a chair and somebody to talk to.
I've turned down three buildings for a proper shop. My hands shook on the last one, and I don't know why.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_clipped: Okay, as you like, papi. I'll be at my chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_noticed_open: Wepa, look at this, a whole story, out loud, and beautifully told. Keep going, I'm sitting down for this.
arg_ask: {player}, mi amor, you decide this one. We both talked, and nobody's listening.
You're the head barber today, {player}. Make the call, and the chatter stops.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_backed_me: Wepa, gracias, {player}. You have good taste, I always said it.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_backed_them: Okay, okay, your call, mi amor. I still think you're wrong, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, eh? Smart, mi amor, like a barber who knows when to just keep cutting.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_always_their_side: They get the vote again, {player}, every argument. I notice, mi amor, I notice everything.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_wallflower: Nobody wants to decide, so I decide. I'm right, and now we eat.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_reject: Ay, no, {player}, not that one. I know that story, and nobody walks out of it happy.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, papi. I'll only complain to the spirits.
orlando_witchdoctor.arg_settled: Half and half, like a good two-tone cut. Okay, we shake on it.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_listens: You wait for people to get the whole story out, {player}. In my shop you'd be the most popular chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_truth: You tell people the truth, {player}, plain and clear. I respect that, I really do.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_jokes: When things get heavy you make everybody laugh, {player}. That's the heart of any good shop.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_stays_out: Other people's quarrels, you leave alone, {player}. Smart, mi amor, like a barber who knows when to just cut.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_biased: The good stuff always lands in one lap, {player}. The whole shop can see it, papi.
orlando_witchdoctor.seen_harsh: Your words have a sharp edge sometimes, {player}. I'm tough, but some of them are soft, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.seed_right: Your advice after that terrible fight, {player}, I made a face at it. Today I did it your way, and it worked.
orlando_witchdoctor.seed_remember: What you told me on the bad day is still sitting in my chair, mi amor. No decision yet.
orlando_witchdoctor.seed_wrong: Your way didn't work for me, {player}, it went worse. Just so you know, with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a minute, {player}? That one nearly got me, and I'm not saying it to the others.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us hit the floor. Sit in my chair, and we go over it slowly, no shouting.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was first to fall, and I'm supposed to notice everything. I notice everything, {player}, and I missed that.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, everybody walked out laughing. That's a Sunday in Santurce, mi gente, the best kind.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_development: A funny question for you, {player}, and be nice. Have I changed? Staying somewhere is on my mind lately, and it never used to be.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been sharp with {name}. I tease everybody, but maybe they didn't know it was with love.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_likes_me: Be straight with me, {player}. Do I make {name} smile, or do they just see the loud one with the scissors?
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me loco, {player}, completely loco. But in a bad fight, I want them in the next chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't right, {player}. They sit in the chair different, heavy, like a man with bad news.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_favour: One thing, {player}, with love. Every good piece lands in {name}'s lap, and the whole shop sees it.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll tell you straight, it's better. Me and {name} are oil and water, and I can't keep smiling through it.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going into places with no back door, {player}. I'll follow you anywhere, but I like a back door.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_wrong: I was wrong about {name}, {player}. They saw it clearly and I didn't, and I'd rather confess it while I'm humble.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_trust: A straight question, mi amor. On the big days, I'm left at camp. Am I the barber you leave behind, or is it only tactics?
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_confrontation_decided: My gear went off with {name}, not one word to me. A simple question, {player}, and I'd have smiled and handed it over.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, mi amor, that helps. Let's eat something.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, I always bounce back. Like good curls.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_aftermath: That's not what I needed to hear. The spirits will listen to me complain.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_development: So you've noticed it too, eh? Good, then it's real.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_development: Maybe so, maybe not, mi amor. Ask me after the next good song.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_development: No, mi amor, that's not it. You read me wrong this time.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, fair enough. I'll sit {name} down and talk, gently, I promise.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, could be not. People are complicated, even for a barber.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. And not a word to {name}, okay?
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, I accept it. A little hurt, but I bounce back.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard every word, {player}. Let it sit with me a while.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the answer. Good to know, mi amor.
orlando_witchdoctor.talk_door_closed: No, papi, I'm done with this one. I'll be at my chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_cracks: A merchant offered me a building today, with a floor and a mirror. I almost said yes, {player}, almost.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_turn: Every time someone offers me a shop, I say no, and I think it's because a building means I'm not going home. Maybe home is where I set up the chair.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_become: I took the building, mi gente, a real shop, floor and mirror and all. Every one of you has a chair there, forever.
orlando_witchdoctor.arc_failed: I said no again, mi amor. I can't take a building yet, I'm not ready. The tent will do.
orlando_witchdoctor.alt_turn: I asked every captain in Booty Bay about sailing east today, {player}. They all laughed, and I asked again anyway.
orlando_witchdoctor.alt_become: I'm going to keep trying to sail home, mi amor, every season. I can't stop, it's my family.
g_roast_after: Still the worst hair in two worlds, mi gente, and you're the only regulars I want.
Loud, messy, never on time, every one of you, and I'd keep you in my shop forever.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_after_wipe_after: Up, mi gente, together, everybody, nobody stays on the floor. We fell, we fix it, and I fix your hair after.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_toast_after: To mi gente, the regulars of Casa Rivera. Every chair is yours, and I mean it.
orlando_witchdoctor.g_crew_after: This is my shop now, all of you, wherever we stop. A real one, with a floor, finally.
g_quiet_line_after: Swept the floor of the new shop tonight. A real floor, mi amor, you have no idea.
Somebody sat in the corner chair today just to talk. It felt like Tuesday at home.
g_loved_after: Gracias, mi amor, and I believe you. That's something new.
Ay, that's beautiful, and I'm keeping it forever.

g_roast: In sixteen years of fourteen-year-olds, class, I never had a group that ignored the plan so politely and so completely.
There's a battle in 1410 that went better than our last fight, and in that one the general fell off his horse.
g_fire_back: That's very good, and I'll mark it as a pass. Next time, though, try to say it when I'm not holding the door for you.
My back row said worse every Tuesday, and they spelled it better, which is the part that really stings.
g_pile_on: Let me add the footnote, class. That was the second time today, and the first one was in front of a signpost.
In their defence, history is full of people who walked confidently in the wrong direction. Most of them got statues.
pavlo_knight.g_peacemake: Both of you sit down, please, and drink some tea. We'll take it in order, first one side, then the other, and nobody interrupts.
pavlo_knight.g_take_side: Forgive me, but I'm with this one. I've seen this argument in four centuries of textbooks, and it always ends the same way.
pavlo_knight.g_left_out: You two are deep in something private, so I'll leave you to it. There's a map that wants drawing over by the fire.
pavlo_knight.g_include: Come and sit with us, there's tea and there's room. Standing at the edge of the room was always the loneliest seat in class.
pavlo_knight.g_bad_plan: Here's a plan from the history books. We march straight up the middle in our best clothes, and we hope they're as polite as we are.
pavlo_knight.g_plan_yes: Good, that's a sensible plan. Tell me how long you need me to hold, and I'll hold exactly that long.
pavlo_knight.g_plan_no: No, I'm sorry, I've read how that one ends, and there's a whole chapter on it. We'll find another way.
pavlo_knight.g_hype: Right, class, the lesson's simple today. Stay behind me, watch your neighbour, and nobody wanders off.
pavlo_knight.g_toast: A short toast, I promise, which from a teacher is a rare thing. To this class, who keep coming back after the bell.
pavlo_knight.g_cheers: Budmo, everyone, which means let's keep being, more or less. It's a good thing to drink to.
g_quiet_line: There was a tower here once, before this one, and nobody remembers who built either. That's most of history, really.
The tea's gone cold again, and that's the third time today. Clearly I'm talking too much.
pavlo_knight.g_after_wipe: Everyone up slowly, and nobody blame anybody yet. First we breathe, then we work out what happened, then we fix it.
pavlo_knight.g_crew: When the bell stopped ringing for good, I thought I'd never have a class again. And here you all are, refusing to do the homework.
pavlo_knight.g_exasperated: I explained it, I drew it in the dirt, I asked if there were questions. And still every one of you ran left.
pavlo_knight.g_love_sharp: You ask the question under the question, the one that matters. That's the student every teacher hopes for.
pavlo_knight.g_love_kind: You care for people without needing them to notice. In my experience that's the rarest lesson of all to learn.
pavlo_knight.g_love_funny: You laughed at my joke about the Treaty of Andrusovo, the only person who ever has. I'll treasure that.
pavlo_knight.g_love_brave: You go first when it's frightening, and you don't make a speech about it. That kind of courage is very old and very quiet.
pavlo_knight.g_love_steady: You don't panic, even when the room does. A wall knows another wall, and it's good to have a second one.
pavlo_knight.g_love_clever: You see the pattern before the rest of us, the way a good historian does. It's a pleasure to watch you think.
pavlo_knight.g_love_honest: You tell people what's so, even the hard version. I taught the hard version every spring, so I respect that.
pavlo_knight.g_love_quiet: You don't fill the silence, and you let a person think. Most people are afraid of that, and you're not.
pavlo_knight.g_love_fierce: You hold on when anybody sensible would let go. History belongs to stubborn people, mostly, and you're one of them.
pavlo_knight.g_love_warm: Being near you feels like the staff room on a good Friday, kettle on, everybody laughing. I'd forgotten that feeling.
g_loved: That's very kind of you, and I'm going to drink my tea and pretend I'm not moved.
Thank you, truly. Nobody's given me a good mark in a long time.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_sharp: You go for the soft place every time, and you enjoy it. I've known bullies in uniform who were gentler.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_kind: You keep fussing over me as if I'm fragile. I'm a large man who stands in front of things, I promise you I'll manage.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_funny: Not everything is a joke, and some things deserve a moment of quiet first. You'll understand that one day, I hope.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_brave: You charge in before you've looked, and somebody always has to stand in the gap you leave. Usually that's me.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait for certainty, and the moment passes. History is mostly people who waited a day too long.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_clever: You explain things to people as if they're slow. A good teacher never does that, and you'd make a poor one.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_honest: Truth with no care in it is just a stone you've thrown. You can be right and still be cruel.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_quiet: You sit there and say nothing, and then nobody knows what you need. Silence isn't always wisdom.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_fierce: Everything with you is a battle, even breakfast. I taught four wars a year, and none of them started over porridge.
pavlo_knight.g_hate_warm: You talk without a pause, and nobody else can get a word in. Let the quiet ones speak, please.
pavlo_knight.g_respect: We don't get on, and I won't pretend we do. But you held your ground back there, and I'll give you full marks for it.
pavlo_knight.g_call_out: That one was yours, and I'll say it plainly. I asked you to wait for my signal, and you didn't wait.
pavlo_knight.g_stung: I see, thank you for telling me. I'll take a short walk and think about it.
pavlo_knight.g_concede: You were correct, and I was not, and I've been turning it over since. A teacher who can't say that should retire.
pavlo_knight.g_nod: And well done to you too, it was good work. We'll leave it at that, before one of us gets sentimental.
pavlo_knight.g_callback_save: I haven't forgotten you hauling me back to my feet. A large man is very difficult to lift, and you managed.
pavlo_knight.g_callback_clutch: Just you and me left, back to back, both of us out of breath. I'll be telling that story to children one day.
pavlo_knight.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I went very quiet for a day. You were right, and it was a useful lesson.
pavlo_knight.g_former_rivals: At the start I had you written down as a difficult student. These days I'd put my shield between you and anything, without a second thought.
pavlo_knight.g_changed: For sixteen years I taught that people don't really change, only their circumstances. Lately I'm marking my own homework wrong.
g_unguarded: Since nobody else is listening, here it is. Two of my six children at the Sepulcher stopped coming, and I've been too afraid to ask them why.
My father drove a tram in Lviv for thirty years, the number two line. Some nights I can still hear the bell, and it's a comfort.
pavlo_knight.g_clipped: Yes, all right, as you like. I'll hold the road.
pavlo_knight.g_noticed_open: Look at that, a whole thought, out loud, in front of everybody. Go on, please, I've been hoping you'd raise your hand.
arg_ask: {player}, would you settle this for us, please? We've both made our case, and neither of us is listening.
You decide, {player}, and we'll both abide by it. That's how it worked in my classroom, more or less.
pavlo_knight.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. That's what the evidence said, and I'm glad you read it too.
pavlo_knight.arg_backed_them: Very well, that's your judgement, and I'll respect it. I may still write a small note in the margin.
pavlo_knight.arg_stayed_out: You'd rather not choose, and that's a reasonable position. Many wise people have taken it.
pavlo_knight.arg_always_their_side: Again it goes to them, {player}, every time we disagree. I've noticed, and I'd rather say so gently than stay quiet.
pavlo_knight.arg_wallflower: Since nobody will decide, I'll do it the teacher's way. The evidence is on my side, and that's the end of the lesson.
pavlo_knight.arg_reject: No, {player}, I can't go along with that one. I've read too many chapters that started exactly this way.
pavlo_knight.arg_grumble: I still believe the evidence was with me. I won't press it, but I'll note it.
pavlo_knight.arg_settled: Let's call it a shared answer, then, half marks each. That's more generous than I was with my students.
pavlo_knight.seen_listens: You let a person finish their thought, {player}, which is rarer than gold. Most of my colleagues never learned it.
pavlo_knight.seen_truth: You give people the true version, {player}, even when the easy one is right there. I taught the hard version too.
pavlo_knight.seen_jokes: When the room goes tense you make it laugh, {player}. Teachers do that on bad days, and it's a kind of care.
pavlo_knight.seen_stays_out: You keep clear of the quarrels, {player}. That's wise, though sometimes a teacher has to step in.
pavlo_knight.seen_biased: One of us gets the lion's share every time, {player}. Children notice favourites first, and so do grown men.
pavlo_knight.seen_harsh: You can be sharp with people, {player}. I've a thick skin from the classroom, but not everyone here has one.
pavlo_knight.seed_right: Your advice after that dreadful fight, {player}, I didn't like it at all. I tried it today, and it worked, so you were right.
pavlo_knight.seed_remember: I'm still thinking about what you told me when things went wrong. I haven't reached a conclusion yet, but I'm close.
pavlo_knight.seed_wrong: I tried your suggestion, {player}, and it went worse, I'm afraid. I thought you'd want to know honestly.
pavlo_knight.talk_aftermath_near_death: Would you sit with me a moment, {player}? That one came very close, closer than I'd like the others to see.
pavlo_knight.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, every one of us. Let's go through it in order, slowly, the way I'd go through a battle with a class.
pavlo_knight.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to fall, and I was the wall. A wall has one job, {player}, and today I didn't do it.
pavlo_knight.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, beginning to end, and everyone walked out. If I still had a register, I'd mark today in gold.
pavlo_knight.talk_development: An odd question for you, {player}. Have you noticed me changing? A student once said I'd been the same since the Middle Ages.
pavlo_knight.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been stern with {name}, too stern, I think. A teacher's voice can land like a stone if you're not careful.
pavlo_knight.talk_relationship_likes_me: Give me a straight answer, {player}. Does {name} like having me around, or am I just the old man with the shield?
pavlo_knight.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I find {name} very difficult, {player}. And yet if the road were breaking, they're the one I'd want beside me.
pavlo_knight.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} has gone quiet in a way I don't like, {player}. I've seen children go quiet like that, and it's rarely nothing.
pavlo_knight.talk_confrontation_favour: I'd like a word, {player}, a fair one. The best equipment keeps going to {name}, and the others are watching it go.
pavlo_knight.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll be honest, because I'd rather you heard it from me. {name} and I don't get along, and I've stopped hiding it.
pavlo_knight.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep taking roads we have no business on, {player}. I'll hold any line you ask, but I'd like it to be worth holding.
pavlo_knight.talk_confrontation_wrong: It's {name}, {player}. Their judgement was sound and mine was not, and I'd rather say so before my pride argues back.
pavlo_knight.talk_confrontation_trust: May I ask you plainly, {player}? When it matters most, you leave me behind. Is that tactics, or is it what you think of me?
pavlo_knight.talk_confrontation_decided: My equipment went to {name}, and nobody spoke to me first. I'd have given it gladly, {player}, if I'd been asked.
pavlo_knight.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, that does help. Let's have some tea.
pavlo_knight.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be all right, in time. I usually am, slowly.
pavlo_knight.talk_stings_aftermath: That wasn't what I needed to hear, I'm afraid. I'll go and stand by the road for a while.
pavlo_knight.talk_lands_development: So you've seen the change too. Good, then I'm not imagining things.
pavlo_knight.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not, the evidence is mixed. We'll see what the next chapter says.
pavlo_knight.talk_stings_development: No, I don't think that's right, {player}. You've misread that page, gently.
pavlo_knight.talk_lands_relationship: That's fair, thank you. I'll go and speak with {name}, carefully.
pavlo_knight.talk_shrug_relationship: It may be so, or it may not. People are the hardest subject, and I taught history.
pavlo_knight.talk_stings_relationship: Then we'll close the book on it, please. And I'd ask you not to repeat it to {name}.
pavlo_knight.talk_lands_confrontation: That's a fair answer, and I accept it. I'm a little bruised, but it'll pass.
pavlo_knight.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've heard you, {player}. Let me think about it over some tea.
pavlo_knight.talk_stings_confrontation: I see, so that's the answer, then. Thank you for being clear with me.
pavlo_knight.talk_door_closed: No, I'd rather not go back over this one. You'll find me holding the road if you need me.
pavlo_knight.arc_cracks: One of the children asked me today what history was for, if the world's gone. I didn't have an answer, {player}, and I always have an answer.
pavlo_knight.arc_turn: I used to believe you could teach people out of doing terrible things. Out here I've watched good people choose them anyway. I'm not sure what I believe now.
pavlo_knight.arc_become: I still believe it, {player}, the teaching. Not because it always works, but because the one time it does is worth every time it doesn't.
pavlo_knight.arc_failed: Perhaps nothing I taught ever mattered. I'll stand on the road, that's what I'm good for, and the chalk can stay in the bag.
pavlo_knight.alt_turn: I've been holding this road for three years now, {player}, and some mornings I can't remember why. The wall's getting thin.
pavlo_knight.alt_become: I'm only a wall now, I think. The teacher went somewhere along the road, and I didn't notice him leave.
g_roast_after: The worst class I ever taught, and I'd teach every one of you again, homework and all.
Look at you all, late, loud and lost, and I wouldn't swap a single one of you for a school.
pavlo_knight.g_after_wipe_after: Everyone up, slowly, and look at me. We fell, we learn, we go again, and that's the only lesson history ever really teaches.
pavlo_knight.g_toast_after: To my class, the best I ever had. You reminded an old teacher why he started.
pavlo_knight.g_crew_after: This is my school now, you lot, here, wherever the road goes. It's one room, and it's enough.
g_quiet_line_after: I taught the children the four wars again today, the whole lesson. Every one of them stayed, and it was a good day.
My chalk's nearly gone, and I'm going to have to ask a dwarf for more. That feels like progress.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I believe you. I'll carry that further than you'd guess.
That's a lovely thing to say, and I'll keep it with the tea.

g_roast: I've seen tidier scrums in the under nines, boys, and half of them were crying for their mams.
Look at this lot, honest to God, if you were scaffolding I'd have to tape you off and put a sign up.
g_fire_back: Oi, I've carried every one of you out of somewhere this month, butt, so mind your mouth now.
That's lush coming from a man who can't tie a bowline without asking it nicely first.
g_pile_on: Duw, he's right though, I watched him walk into the same branch twice, isn't it, same branch.
And then he tried to blame the map, boys, as if the map had moved the tree.
rhodri_knight.g_peacemake: Right, enough now, the pair of you, before I pick you both up and put you on different sides of the road.
rhodri_knight.g_take_side: Sorry, butt, I'm with him on this one, and I'd say so to your face in the pub.
rhodri_knight.g_left_out: No, you carry on, the two of you, I'll go and check the straps on the cart, someone has to.
rhodri_knight.g_include: Come here, mun, get in by the fire, there's a cuppa with your name on it and I won't take no.
rhodri_knight.g_bad_plan: Now, hear me out, boys, what if I just run at the door, proper front row, and we find out which of us is harder?
rhodri_knight.g_plan_yes: Tidy, I'm in, and if it goes wrong at least it'll make a lush story at the bar.
rhodri_knight.g_plan_no: No chance, butt, I've built enough things to know when one's about to fall over, and that one's leaning already.
rhodri_knight.g_hype: Right, boys, heads up, bind on, and nobody steps back! We go in like it's the last ten minutes against Cardiff.
rhodri_knight.g_toast: Glasses up, this lot! To the boys who stand where the weight comes, and to the pint after.
rhodri_knight.g_cheers: Iechyd da, everyone, and somebody start a song before I do it myself.
g_quiet_line: That strap's going to go, by the way, the brown one, I'll sort it now in a minute.
Well, there we are then, as my mam would say, and put the kettle on.
rhodri_knight.g_after_wipe: Up you get, boys, slowly now, nobody's broken, I checked. We go again once we've had a cuppa.
rhodri_knight.g_crew: You're my front row now, the lot of you. I'd stand in front of anything for any of you, and that's not talk.
rhodri_knight.g_exasperated: Duw, Duw, the state of you! Will one of you please check a knot before you jump off something?
rhodri_knight.g_love_sharp: You say it straight and quick, butt, like a good ref. No messing, no dressing it up, I love that.
rhodri_knight.g_love_kind: You look after people without a fuss, butt. My mam's like that, and it's the best thing a person can be.
rhodri_knight.g_love_funny: You make me laugh till my ribs hurt, and I've had my ribs stood on by Bridgend forwards. That's saying something.
rhodri_knight.g_love_brave: You go in first like a proper flanker, no thought for yourself, and I'll always be right behind you.
rhodri_knight.g_love_steady: You don't move, butt, whatever comes at you. That's the best thing I can say about anyone, on a pitch or off it.
rhodri_knight.g_love_clever: Your head works like a good engineer's, butt, you see how the weight sits in a thing. I could listen to you all night.
rhodri_knight.g_love_honest: You've never told me a job was fine when it wasn't. In my trade that's what keeps people alive.
rhodri_knight.g_love_quiet: You don't say much, butt, but when you do it's worth hearing. Like a good tighthead, all work, no noise.
rhodri_knight.g_love_fierce: Quit isn't in you, mun, not once. You'd have made a lush number seven.
rhodri_knight.g_love_warm: You make anywhere feel like the clubhouse on a Saturday, butt, and I've missed that more than I'll say.
g_loved: Get away with you, you'll have me welling up, and I'm a big lump to have crying on you.
Duw, now I've got to buy you a pint, that's the rules, I don't make them.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_sharp: You've always got to have the clever little dig, haven't you? It's not big, butt, it's just small.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_kind: You fuss over me like I'm made of glass, and I'm the size of a door. Leave off, mun.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_funny: Not everything's a laugh, butt, some things you take seriously or somebody gets hurt.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_brave: You run in without looking, every time, and one day I won't be quick enough to stand in front of you.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_steady: You'd check the same knot ten times, mun, and the job's still not done by teatime.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_clever: You explain it to me like I'm thick, butt. I build things for a living, I know how weight works.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_honest: You say every last thing you think, the second you think it. Some things want a minute first, mun.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_quiet: Not a word out of you all day, and I can't tell if you're fine or about to fall off something.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a contest with you, even the walking. It's not a cup final, butt, it's a road.
rhodri_knight.g_hate_warm: Your mouth hasn't stopped since breakfast, butt, and I've shared a minibus with a whole rugby team.
rhodri_knight.g_respect: I'm not going to pretend I like you, butt. But you held your ground back there, and I'll shake your hand for that much.
rhodri_knight.g_call_out: That one's on you, butt, and you know it. You went in before anyone was set and I had to scrape you off the floor.
rhodri_knight.g_stung: Right, tidy, thank you for that. I'm going to check some knots for a bit, on my own.
rhodri_knight.g_concede: Fair play, butt, back there, that was me, and I've been chewing it over. Here, I've redone your strap, it was going anyway.
rhodri_knight.g_nod: Don't go making a speech of it. You did all right yourself, mind, I'll say that much.
rhodri_knight.g_callback_save: You remember pulling me out of that mine, butt? I'm buying your pints until the day I die for that.
rhodri_knight.g_callback_clutch: Last two standing, you and me, and you said we should've brought a ball. Best moment I've had in this world.
rhodri_knight.g_callback_callout: Last time you had a go at me I sulked for a whole day, butt, and you were right, which was worse.
rhodri_knight.g_former_rivals: When I met you I wanted to put you through a wall, butt, no word of a lie, and now here we are, cwtching.
rhodri_knight.g_changed: I let the fire come today and I didn't flinch from it, and I didn't enjoy it either. Just held it, steady, like a scrum.
g_unguarded: Come here, all of you, I'll tell you the real reason I sing up the scaffold. It's so my hands don't shake.
My nephews used to stand on my feet and I'd walk them round the kitchen like that. I think about it every morning.
rhodri_knight.g_clipped: Fine, butt, I'll be checking the cart. Shout if you need lifting.
rhodri_knight.g_noticed_open: Listen to you, butt, chatting away like a Saturday night! I knew you had it in you, mun.
arg_ask: {player}, you tell him, go on, you've got the sense here and he won't listen to a scaffolder.
Right, {player}, you're the ref, you make the call, and whoever loses buys the first round.
rhodri_knight.arg_backed_me: There we are, the ref has spoken! Your round then, butt, and get me a big one.
rhodri_knight.arg_backed_them: Fair enough, ref's decision, I'll take it on the chin. Wrong, mind, but I'll take it.
rhodri_knight.arg_stayed_out: Useless, {player}, like a ref who's left his whistle in the car.
rhodri_knight.arg_always_their_side: Every call goes his way, {player}, every one. I'm starting to think you're on his team.
rhodri_knight.arg_wallflower: No ref, then, so I'm calling it myself. I win, butt, and you're making the tea.
rhodri_knight.arg_reject: No, with respect, {player}, no. I've been up a pole in a gale, and I know which way this falls.
rhodri_knight.arg_grumble: Still think I was right about that, butt, I'm only mentioning it the once over my pint.
rhodri_knight.arg_settled: Ah, come here, we're both half right, isn't it. Shake on it and we'll call it a draw.
rhodri_knight.seen_listens: You let a man finish his story, {player}. My dad's like that, and it's rarer than you'd think.
rhodri_knight.seen_truth: No messing with you, {player}, you'd tell me if my ties weren't holding. I trust that.
rhodri_knight.seen_jokes: Every time it goes wrong you crack a joke, {player}, like a captain in the huddle, and it works.
rhodri_knight.seen_stays_out: You keep well out of other people's rows, {player}. Wise man, my mam would like you.
rhodri_knight.seen_biased: There's a teacher's pet in this lot, {player}, and the whole stand can see who it is.
rhodri_knight.seen_harsh: You can be hard on people, {player}. I'm a big lad, but some of these aren't, mind.
rhodri_knight.seed_right: {player}, what you told me that day we all got flattened, I didn't like it one bit. Today it kept me on my feet, so ta.
rhodri_knight.seed_remember: That thing you said to me, after the bad day, it's been going round my head like a hymn I can't finish.
rhodri_knight.seed_wrong: I tried it your way, {player}, honest, and it went worse. No hard feelings, just letting you know.
rhodri_knight.talk_aftermath_near_death: Got a minute, {player}? That was close, and I felt the fire come up again, and I wanted it to.
rhodri_knight.talk_aftermath_wipe: The whole lot of us flattened, {player}, like a collapsed scrum. I keep counting heads, can't stop myself.
rhodri_knight.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} hit the deck before anyone, and I was stood right next to him, {player}. I'm meant to be the one in front.
rhodri_knight.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, {player}, the whole thing, start to whistle! I want to sing, honest to God, stop me.
